jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager - C
jobs.description:
The most security-conscious organizations trust Telos Corporation to protect their vital IT assets. The reputation of our company rests on the quality of our solution and the integrity of our people. Explore what you can bring to our solutions in information assurance, secure networks, secure enterprise messaging, and identity management.

Be a part of the Telos culture and see what sets us apart! Telos offers an excellent compensation package with benefits that include generous paid time off, medical, dental, vision, tuition reimbursement, and 401k. Our employees enjoy more than just a great work environment! Salary: $Min 104,240.00 Max 156,360.00 per year, depending on experience and qualifications. Telos offers an excellent compensation package with benefits that include generous paid time off, medical, dental, vision, tuition reimbursement, and 401k.

This position will be based at Ashburn/Remote - Travel 25%

Responsibilities

Integrated Program Management: Develop, execute, and maintain Integrated Program Management Plans (IPMP) in accordance with contractual requirements and company policies, procedures, and processes covering all areas of project management.
Cost and Schedule Management: Develop cost and schedule baselines; monitor and control against these baselines, report on and mitigate variances.
Risk and Issue Management: Identify, categorize, and prioritize risks and opportunities; plan, monitor, and control risk responses; manage and reduce the impact of known issues.
Project Communication: Develop and implement communication plans; chair Kick-off Meetings, Weekly Status Meetings, Project Management Reviews (PMRs), Integrated Project Team Meetings (IPTs), and other meetings as required; develop, review, and facilitate the delivery of CDRL documentation; communicate project plans, schedules, risks, issues, opportunities, coordinate site visits/travel, and provide performance against plan information.
Stakeholder Management: Identify and manage project stakeholders to ensure unimpeded project progress.
Scope and Change Management: Understand project scope and manage changes in accordance with company and customer requirements.
Configuration Management: Develop, manage, and maintain the integrity of the configuration management baseline.
Continuous Improvement: Contribute lessons learned and process improvement suggestions to the organization; communicate best practices and maintain consistency across all projects.
Team Management: Ensure the project team is fully staffed to complete the project on time and with quality; verify all staff members maintain required training and certifications, and ensure proper access and clearances per contract requirements.
Supplier and Subcontractor Management: Develop, execute, and maintain a Subcontractor Management Plan in accordance with company and contractual requirements; ensure quality subcontractor and vendor products and deliverables prior to acceptance; work closely with the Logistics team for asset management.
Site Coordination: Coordinate site visits for project team members to perform onsite work such as site surveys and installation.
Compliance: Comply with applicable CMMI and ISO processes; participate in periodic audits and appraisals as required.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in a related technical discipline and 5-7 years of experience or the equivalent combination of education, professional training, and work experience.
Certification: Project Management Institute (PMI) Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent required.
Experience:
Experience running solutions development and implementation-type projects, preferably networking, communications, and infrastructure (voice, BAN, wireless, ISP, OSP).
Experience driving the project team through the solutions development and implementation process from the concept-level in the bid phase, through execution of survey, design (preliminary, detailed/critical), procurement, implementation, secure (cybersecurity/information assurance), testing, training, and transition to Operations and Maintenance.
Experience managing a solution against contractual technical requirements including comprehensive environmental requirements.
Experience building and managing relationships with Government, subcontractor, internal, and support stakeholders in order to successfully meet CDRL, documentation, and milestone delivery requirements.
Experience working for or with the US Military (Air Force, Army, Marine Corps, Navy, etc.).
Experience in all areas of project management including cost, schedule, quality, procurement, risk/issue/opportunity, stakeholder, and communication management.
Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact with people at all levels; accustomed to facilitating meetings, briefing project status and performance, and managing a multi-discipline and geographically dispersed team.
A professional attitude with attention to detail, customer service, and excellent organizational skills.
Preferred Experience:
Experience with CMMI for Development or similar frameworks.

The successful candidate must meet eligibility requirements to access sensitive information, which requires US citizenship.

Therefore, any employment with Telos will also be contingent upon confirmation from the Social Security Administration ("SSA") and/or the Department of Homeland Security ("DHS") of your authorization to work in the United States. jobs.title: Project Manager - Implementation
jobs.description:
Overview Of 73 Strings

73 Strings is an innovative platform providing comprehensive data extraction, monitoring, and valuation solutions for the private capital industry. The company's AI-powered platform streamlines middle-office processes for alternative investments, enabling seamless data structuring and standardization, monitoring, and fair value estimation at the click of a button. 73 Strings serves clients globally across various strategies, including Private Equity, Growth Equity, Venture Capital, Infrastructure and Private Credit.

Our 2025 $55M Series B, the largest in the industry, was led by Goldman Sachs, with participation from Golub Capital and Hamilton Lane, with continued support from Blackstone, Fidelity International Strategic Ventures and Broadhaven Ventures.

About The Role

We are looking for an enthusiastic and energetic associate to join our team of incredibly talented experienced financial advisory, valuation professionals and engineers. As a Project Manager at 73 Strings, you will work on portfolio monitoring and valuation aspects, contributing to the development of products that utilize cutting-edge technology to deliver innovative solutions for the financial services industry. You will work with largest Private Market firms independently and be one of the first to explore uncharted territories at the intersection of AI and corporate finance.

The ideal candidate demonstrates proficiency in leveraging AI tools to automate workflows and optimize daily output. We value individuals who proactively integrate emerging technologies to enhance efficiency and deliver high quality results.

The role is remote in Canada.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end implementations independently, serving as both Project Manager and Subject Matter Expert for sophisticated private market investors across diverse strategies (Private Equity, Venture Capital, Private Credit, Real Estate, etc.) and global regions.

Develop, refine, and train the team on best practices, creating and maintaining essential implementation artifacts to drive successful client outcomes.
Proactively monitor customer health and engagement levels, addressing potential issues before they arise to ensure client satisfaction.
Proactively monitor customer health and engagement levels, addressing potential issues before they arise to ensure client satisfaction.
Collaborate with product development teams to create and enhance portfolio monitoring and valuation features tailored to the needs of the financial advisory industry.
Partner with clients to optimize data strategies and integrate technology stacks, driving efficiency and alignment with best practices.
Deliver high-quality, client-facing materials that facilitate understanding of complex project requirements.
Work closely with leadership to continuously improve the implementation and client onboarding experience.
Partner with technology and SME teams to develop effective algorithms and workflows for automating critical tasks.

Qualifications
Bachelor’s or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in professional services within financial services, private equity, investment banking, fintech, or related industries.
Demonstrated expertise in project management methodologies, with a proven track record of independently managing complex client projects.
Knowledge of Private Equity and Private Credit valuation methodologies is highly beneficial, enabling deeper insights into client needs and project requirements.
Strong critical thinking and time management abilities, with the capacity to prioritize effectively under tight deadlines.
Self-motivated with a strong commitment to continuous learning, growth, and performance excellence.
Excellent analytical skills and the ability to create and deliver presentations tailored to the audience’s needs.
Working knowledge of APIs and SQL is advantageous.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including PowerPoint and Power BI, for data analysis and presentation.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, along with strong collaboration abilities.

We cultivate a culture of innovation and collaboration, where your ideas matter. We empower our team members to take initiative, learn continuously, and thrive in a supportive environment.

jobs.company: CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services
jobs.title: Project Manager II/Senior, Real World Evidence/ Late Phase Research
jobs.description:
About CTI

CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit www.ctifacts.com

Job Purpose/ Summary:
Responsible for overseeing and coordinating all operational aspects of Real World Evidence (RWE) clinical studies and projects according to contract ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction from planning to completion. Manage and represent assigned functional study team members in RWE studies and projects.

What You'll Do:

Oversee and manage RWE clinical studies and other clinical projects. RWE clinical studies include, but are not limited to: Disease or drug registries, Natural History of Disease studies, Post-marketing required studies, Decentralized trials, Pragmatic trials, Long term follow-up studies, Retrospective studies, Early Access Programs (EAP’s), Other clinical programs primarily observational or low-interventional in design
Other areas of oversight and coordination could include, but are not limited to the following project types, in conjunction with research scientists: Systematic Literature Reviews and Meta Analyses, Database analyses, Development of Economic models, Oversight of advisory boards, surveys and feasibility assessments, Additional medical writing activities (protocols, clinical study reports, abstracts, manuscripts, posters and white papers)
Manage multi-functional study teams throughout the study or project from kick-off through close-out. Responsible for ensuring all functional areas study team members deliver in a timely manner, on budget and with high quality throughout the duration of the study. Responsible for escalation of potential issues to leadership, as necessary.
Assist in study resourcing needs with other functional areas, when needed. Ensure proper transition with any new study team members throughout the study.
Work closely with the client and team to initiate study start-up and kick off. Organize and lead study kick-off meetings and ongoing client meetings throughout the duration of the study or project.
Develop timelines, trackers, project management plans and provide oversight for other key functional plans to ensure they are developed, reviewed and approved by the client, based on study scope.
Monitor for potential issues and risks throughout the study, quickly identify and escalate to leadership as needed, brainstorm solutions to present to the study team and client.
Prepare or oversee development, review, and finalization of deliverables for clients and senior management. Provide project status reports to client and management.
Manage timelines and budgets, collaborating with finance and leadership to ensure project remains on time and in budget. Conduct regular reviews of the budget and scope, including revenue recognition and approval of milestone payments. When needed, initiate out of scope notifications to clients.
Ensure training and utilization of various systems to support RWE programs, including but not limited to CTMS, eTMF, data systems, Smart Sheet and any others requested by clients.
Interact with multidisciplinary departments.
Develop project-specific operating procedures (PSOPs), as necessary, with responsible functional areas
Assist in the development and leadership of presentations at client and Investigator Meetings, including bid defense meetings.
Provide day-to-day oversight of CRA tasks on assigned projects when a lead CRA is not assigned.

What You'll Bring:

Bachelor’s Degree or above in a health science field, epidemiology, public health, pharmaceutical or medical device research, or related health science field
5 years real world evidence, clinical or business background in drug or device research/development, biotechnology, pharmaceutical or clinical research and/or combination of education & experience
Experience with real world evidence, drug development process and/or medical writing preferred
Experience in the oversight of Monitoring activities preferred

Why CTI?

Advance Your Career – We invest in your professional growth. Through a structured mentoring program, leadership development courses, and access to ongoing education and training opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, you’ll have the tools to achieve your goals. Our dedicated training department supports your successful career at CTI.
Be Part of an Award-Winning Team – Join a global team spanning 60 countries, recognized for its award-winning culture that prioritizes people. We support your work-life balance with generous health benefits, vacation packages, hybrid work opportunities, and paid parental leave. Through our CTI Cares program, you’ll have opportunities to give back to your community and the world.
Make a Lasting Impact – At CTI, your work directly contributes to advancing medicine. You’ll play a vital role in developing life-changing treatments for patients with chronic and critical illnesses. Together, we move medicine forward, making a difference for those who need it most.

Important Note

In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an @ctifacts.com
email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website (www.ctifacts.com) or from our verified LinkedIn page.

Please Note

We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

jobs.title: Project Manager-ATM
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend
is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the role

Turner & Townsend
is seeking an experienced Project Manager – ATM
to support the planning, delivery, and implementation of Automated Teller Machine (ATM), banking technology, and branch transformation programs. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation through deployment, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, business requirements, schedule, budget, quality, and operational standards.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing technology deployment, financial services, infrastructure, or retail banking projects in a client-facing environment. This role requires strong stakeholder management, organizational, and project delivery skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams across geographically dispersed locations.

As a key member of the project team, the Project Manager will drive successful project outcomes while promoting Turner & Townsend's values, methodologies, and commitment to delivering better outcomes for our clients.

What you'll do

Manage ATM deployment, upgrade, replacement, and branch technology projects throughout the project lifecycle.
Coordinate project activities among clients, vendors, contractors, technology providers, and operational stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, risk registers, and implementation plans.
Monitor project progress and ensure milestones, deliverables, and client objectives are achieved.
Lead project meetings, status reviews, stakeholder communications, and reporting activities.
Manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and change control processes.
Coordinate site readiness, installation activities, testing, commissioning, and operational transition requirements.
Oversee vendor performance and ensure compliance with project requirements, standards, and service level expectations.
Track project financial performance, forecasts, and budget status in collaboration with project controls teams.
Support procurement, contract administration, and resource coordination activities.
Ensure project documentation is properly maintained and aligned with governance requirements.
Provide regular project status updates, dashboards, and executive-level reporting to stakeholders.
Facilitate issue resolution and decision-making to support successful project delivery.
Promote continuous improvement and the adoption of Turner & Townsend project management best practices.
Build strong client relationships and identify opportunities to enhance service delivery.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in project management, program management, technology deployments, banking infrastructure, or related fields.
Experience managing ATM deployment, branch transformation, retail banking, technology rollout, or infrastructure projects is preferred.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, vendors, and geographically distributed project teams.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication, presentation, and client management capabilities.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification preferred.

Additional Information

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects:

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

It is strictly against Turner & Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner & Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time.

Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner & Townsend personal e-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner & Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner & Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.

jobs.title: Title: Senior Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations
jobs.description:
Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

Title: Senior Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations

Reports to:
Senior Director, Project Management

Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading high-impact internal projects and strategic initiatives across the IMC Project Management organization. This role partners with Project Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive operational excellence, support commercial and business development activities, provide financial reporting and analysis, and lead integration and process improvement initiatives. The Senior Project Manager serves as an internal subject-matter expert, using strong project management, analytical, and influencing skills to translate business priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Business Development Support

Support commercial activities including RFPs, RFIs, proposal development, and budget reviews.
Provide Project Management and operational expertise to help ensure proposed solutions, budgets, assumptions, timelines, and resource requirements are operationally sound.
Partner with Business Development, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to support opportunity planning and proposal development.
Identify operational, financial, resource, and execution risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
Support internal preparation for bid defenses, capability presentations, and other Business Development activities.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Developing and facilitating regular Project Profitability processes and governance.
Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis across the Project Management organization.
Analyze financial and operational performance to identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.
Partner with Finance and Project Management leadership to investigate variances and support development of appropriate action plans.
Evaluate the financial impact of operational decisions and provide actionable insights to support leadership decision-making.
Support continuous improvement of financial reporting, forecasting accuracy, and financial visibility.

Strategic Project Management & Operational Excellence

Lead and coordinate complex internal projects and strategic initiatives, establishing clear plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and accountabilities.
Support integration, organizational change, and other cross-functional initiatives impacting Project Management.
Lead and support process improvement activities focused on increasing efficiency, consistency, standardization, and operational effectiveness.
Develop and implement improved workflows, tools, processes, and ways of working in partnership with key stakeholders.
Provide support as requested with clear reporting, analysis, recommendations, and visibility to progress, risks, and outcomes.
Other ad hoc support requests from Sr. Director, Project Management

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in project management, business administration, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Significant project management experience within a complex, cross-functional organization preferably in clinical trials or pharmaceutical industry.
Demonstrated experience leading strategic, operational, integration, or process-improvement initiatives.
Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
Experience supporting RFPs, RFIs, proposal development, budget reviews, or Business Development activities preferred.
Advanced to expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, complex formulas, data validation and analysis, financial and resource tracking, forecasting, and development of project-level and portfolio-level reporting.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results across functions without formal reporting authority.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
Project management certification, such as PMP, preferred.

Key Competencies

Strategic project management
Financial and business acumen
Commercial and Business Development support
Data analysis and performance reporting
Process improvement and operational excellence
Integration and change management
Cross-functional leadership and influence
Risk management and problem solving
Executive-level communication

What ICON Can Offer You

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

Our Benefits Examples Include

Various annual leave entitlements
A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well-being.
Life assurance
Flexible country-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager I
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands OR Germany - Remote

Travel:
up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed)
Reports to:
Director, Professional Services, EMEA

Your Impact

As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you’ll lead high-visibility projects, directly contributing to the development and implementation of solutions that truly make a difference. In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust.

At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose.

What You’ll Do

Program & Project Management

Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments
Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management.
Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery.
Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition
Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff.
Operates with a sense of urgency, accuracy, and detail-orientation, while maintaining consistent lines of communication with all teams involved in each project
Maintain customer confidence, especially in high-pressure situations
Remain organized and focused on removing obstacles through creativity and adaptation to rapidly changing circumstances

Partner Management

Own the relationship with 3rd party integrator and the client throughout the length of the contract

Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with Professional Services, Product Managers, and Engineers to align program execution with business goals.
Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment.

Process Improvement

Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to increase deployment speed, quality, and customer satisfaction.
Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices.

What You Bring

Fluency in both German and English

jobs.description:
Why IPS?

If you're searching for a place where you can grow, continue learning, and make a meaningful impact while still having time for the people and moments that matter most, welcome to Integrated Power Services! Because when people thrive, businesses thrive. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we invite you to join us!

Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO)
401k Employer Match
Bonus Incentives
Extensive Training & Career Development Programs
Tuition Reimbursement Program
Medical, Dental and Vision plans
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
And more!

This is a remote, territory-based role supporting customers throughout Florida. Regular travel within the region is required.

Responsibilities & Expectations

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of PowerGuard projects from order handoff through final completion and closeout. This position serves as the primary point of coordination between the customer, sales, operations, service, suppliers, subcontractors, and other internal teams.

The Project Manager will take ownership of project schedules, communication, documentation, financial performance, equipment and material coordination, and issue resolution. The goal of this role is to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within scope and budget, while providing our customers with a high level of communication and service.

Manage assigned projects from sales handoff through completion, invoicing, and project closeout.
Review project scope, specifications, proposals, purchase orders, contracts, equipment requirements, and customer expectations at project kickoff.
Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and required customer commitments.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution and provide regular, proactive status updates.
Coordinate equipment, materials, subcontractors, freight, site requirements, startup, commissioning, and other project activities.
Work closely with PowerGuard sales, service, operations, purchasing, and administrative teams to ensure projects move forward without unnecessary delays.
Monitor project costs, revenue, gross margin, change orders, billing milestones, and overall financial performance.
Identify potential scope changes and ensure change orders are properly documented and approved before additional work is performed.
Identify project risks or delays early and develop action plans to keep projects on schedule.
Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers regarding equipment availability, documentation, technical requirements, and delivery schedules.
Conduct regular project reviews and maintain accurate project documentation, correspondence, schedules, and customer commitments.
Escalate significant technical, commercial, scheduling, or customer issues when additional support is required.
Coordinate project turnover to the appropriate service/support teams upon completion.
Ensure final documentation, customer acceptance, invoicing requirements, and closeout activities are completed promptly.
Support continuous improvement of PowerGuard’s project management processes and customer experience.

Qualifications And Competencies

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, construction management, project management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant industry experience will be considered.
Prior project management experience in power generation, electrical equipment, construction, industrial services, mechanical/electrical contracting, or a related technical industry preferred.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously with responsibility for schedule, cost, customer communication, and execution.
Strong financial understanding, including project budgets, revenue, margin, cost tracking, forecasting, and change-order management.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage changing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively across sales, operations, service, purchasing, finance, customers, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Comfortable holding internal and external stakeholders accountable for project commitments and deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/business management systems.
Experience with standby and distributed power generation systems, including generator sets, automatic transfer switches, switchgear, paralleling equipment, and associated electrical/mechanical systems preferred,
Experience working with generator manufacturers, electrical contractors, general contractors, consulting engineers, and end users preferred.
Familiarity with Rehlko/Kohler or other major power-generation equipment is a plus.
PMP certification or formal project-management training is a plus but not required.

You’ll thrive at IPS if you…

Lead with integrity and prioritize safety. You demonstrate high standards and commit to a safe, ethical workplace.
Value teamwork and accountability. You work well with others, take responsibility, serve others, and deliver on your commitments.
Focus on the customer. You are dedicated to providing an unmatched customer experience and exceeding expectations.
Have an entrepreneurial spirit. You’re proactive, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Communicate effectively and with purpose. You keep everyone informed with clear, concise communication.
Stay curious and love to learn. You continuously seek new knowledge and grow personally and professionally.

Who We Are

At IPS, we're committed to empowering you to make a meaningful impact. As the industry's leading and fastest-growing service provider, IPS offers single-source electromechanical and power management solutions to enhance the reliability of critical infrastructure across North America and the United Kingdom. We serve over 40,000 essential customer locations, from renewable energy pioneers to hospitals, manufacturers, and municipalities, helping them avoid costly downtime and ensure mission-critical operations.

When you join IPS, you're joining a team that's revolutionizing equipment and process reliability across diverse sectors, from power generation to petrochemicals, and beyond. You'll learn from industry experts, grow alongside a talented workforce, and be part of a company that is built on the Shared Values of Safety, Integrity, Teamwork, Accountability, Customer Focus, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.

IPS is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background and driving record investigation. As a federal contractor, our company is committed to maintaining a safe and drug-free workplace. Candidates for this position are required to complete a pre-employment drug screen successfully. The drug screening process will include testing for substances that may impair one's ability to perform the job safely and effectively.

jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could redefine what's possible? With us, you can.

You want Purpose. Growth. Opportunity. People who get it.

We are the home of ambitious, passionate, and innovative world shapers.

With an unmatched breadth and depth of engineering, advisory and science-based expertise, our global minds unite to power local solutions.

We are pathfinders and impact makers.

We are Visioneers.

We are WSP.

The Opportunity

Build the Future with Us

Join WSP's Building Sciences team as a Project Manager and Technical Lead
, where you'll play a key role in restoring, renewing, and enhancing existing buildings across Ontario.

We are seeking an experienced building science professional with a strong background in building envelope restoration and rehabilitation to lead multidisciplinary project teams and provide technical leadership on complex restoration projects.

As a Technical Lead, you will be responsible for the technical quality of projects, ensuring deliverables meet WSP standards and align with client objectives, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements. You will provide technical oversight throughout the project lifecycle while mentoring and developing the next generation of building science professionals.

WSP is home to one of Canada's largest Building Sciences practices. Our GTA Building Sciences team includes more than 80 professionals across Toronto and Thornhill, bringing together expertise in building envelope engineering, material science, restoration engineering, constructability, project management, cost estimating, reserve fund planning, and asset management.

Building Sciences is focused on helping building owners and managers understand, maintain, restore, and improve their assets. We work as trusted advisors, delivering practical, value-driven solutions backed by deep technical expertise and an understanding of the built environment.

Your Impact

As a Project Manager and Technical Lead, you will:

Lead building condition assessments, forensic investigations, and rehabilitation projects across commercial, institutional, residential, and mixed-use building portfolios.
Provide technical leadership on complex building envelope restoration projects involving masonry, concrete, stone, glazing systems, roofing, waterproofing, and sealant renewal.
Establish project-specific methodologies, design criteria, and quality standards that drive successful project outcomes and long-term asset performance.
Guide multidisciplinary teams through assessment, design, tendering, contract administration, construction review, and project closeout activities.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by providing risk assessments, restoration strategies, and practical recommendations that support informed decision-making.
Mentor and develop junior and intermediate professionals through technical reviews, field investigations, site visits, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Strengthen client relationships and support business growth through proposal development, fee preparation, presentations, and industry engagement.
Champion WSP's commitment to quality, safety, environmental stewardship, collaboration, and technical excellence.

The Skills That Set You Apart

8+ years of progressive experience delivering building sciences, restoration engineering, or building envelope projects within Ontario.
Demonstrated expertise in the assessment, design, and restoration of existing building envelope systems.
Strong technical knowledge of masonry, concrete, stone, curtain wall, glazing, roofing, waterproofing, and sealant restoration practices.
Licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Ontario; other relevant professional designations will be considered.
Proven experience leading multidisciplinary project teams through investigation, design, tendering, construction review, and contract administration phases.
Strong project management capabilities, including scope, schedule, budget, resource planning, and client relationship management.
Excellent technical writing, communication, presentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to influence technical decision-making.
Valid Ontario driver's licence with a willingness to travel for site reviews, field investigations, and client meetings.

Why Choose WSP?

We exist to shape communities to advance humanity. The brightest engineers, advisors and scientists from across the globe call WSP home.

Proudly Canadian – we are a Top 100 Employer in Canada for 2026.
A global community of brilliant minds – your next idea, mentor, or opportunity is always within reach.
Limitless opportunities start here. Whether it's across the country or around the globe, we help you tailor your role to match your ambition because your growth drives ours.
Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

#WeAreWSP

$114,600 – $151,800

MB & ON:
$104,500 – $143,900

NB, NL, NS, PE & QC:
$103,500 – $137,400

Disclosure

The final salary awarded for this role may vary from the above range based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs. The wage range provided in this job posting may be subject to change for business purposes.

Make Your Mark with WSP

Ready to help shape the future of Canada's built environment?

Join one of the country's largest and most respected Building Sciences teams and play a leading role in restoring, renewing, and strengthening the buildings that support our communities. If you're driven by technical excellence, mentorship, client impact, and meaningful project work, we'd love to hear from you.

About Us

Apply today and help redefine what's possible with WSP.

At WSP
, we exist to shape communities to advance humanity.

It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, we partner with clients across transportation, infrastructure, environment, buildings, energy, water, mining and metals. We pair deep local knowledge with global insights to pioneer solutions designed to leave a lasting, positive impact.

At WSP
, you’ll join a community of brilliant minds that push boundaries every day - applying deep expertise and fuelling innovation to help create a more connected and resilient future. Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose.

Join us.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

About The Role

Communicate program progress, risks, and key decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
Establish and refine program management practices that improve planning, coordination, accountability, and delivery predictability.

7+ years of experience in Technical Program Management, leading complex, cross-functional software development programs.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in AI/ML, developer tools, code transformation, or software platform technologies.
Experience working on research-driven product development and translating emerging technologies into commercial products.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations:
Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About The Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About The Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.
Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.
Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.
Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.
Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.
Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.
Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.
Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.
Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.
Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.
Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.
Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.
Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.
Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.
Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.
Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.
Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.
Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.
Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.
Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).
Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.
Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.
Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.
Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.
Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.
Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $189,000
For New York, Washington DC, Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000
For Austin Texas based hires: Estimated annual salary of $108,000 - $149,000

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Program Manager

Location: Columbus, Ohio

Remote / In office every two weeks

Description:

DSI is searching for a Program Manager (PM) who will oversee, lead, and administer the setting up and implementation of a Salesforce Program. The PM is the individual ultimately responsible to the agency. The PM's primary responsibility is to drive the entire efforts for setting up the Salesforce Org, oversee the implement of Salesforce projects, application rewrites, governance, and operations. The PM must ensure that any risks to projects are addressed to assist with timely completion and that the final product meets the business, technical, and established quality requirements.

The PM will provide the following:

Strategic Planning & Leadership
Define and drive the overall Salesforce program vision, strategy, and roadmap.
Align Salesforce initiatives with business goals and stakeholder priorities.
Lead cross-functional teams in program planning and execution.

Program Oversight
Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of Salesforce-related projects and initiatives.
Oversee timelines, budgets, deliverables, and resource allocation.
Ensure governance, risk management, and compliance across Salesforce implementations.

Stakeholder Management
Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams.
Facilitate requirements gathering, prioritization, and expectation setting.
Communicate status updates, milestones, and issues to senior leadership.

jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with a technical screen with the hiring manager that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and four 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence.
Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams.
Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability.
Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation.
Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance).
Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performant
Mentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

Bachelor's in a technical field such as computer science, mathematics, statistics or equivalent years of experience
6+ years of experience spanning Engineering / Data Science / Technical Program Management leading cross-functional efforts in the software or tech industry in a data-driven environment.
3+ years of experience in Technical Program Management .
A proven track record of leading large-scale, ambiguous programs across distributed teams in fast-paced, cross-functional environments, especially in the areas of improving platform reliability, operational stability and performance of production systems
Strong proficiency with Python and SQL, and experience using data to analyze systems, build tools, or inform decisions.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Grafana, Looker, Tableau) building dashboards, source control (e.g. GitHub), ticket management (e.g. JIRA).
Experience working directly with engineers and contributing to technical design, architectural trade-offs, and roadmap planning.
Comfort operating with high visibility and accountability; you thrive on ownership and impact.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new domains, systems, and technologies.
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

A background in software engineering, infrastructure systems
Prior hands-on experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Airflow, Hive, Kafka, or Flink.
Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP) and containerization tools like Kubernetes or Docker.
Background in building internal tools or developer platforms to improve engineering velocity and system reliability.
Experience managing production systems, reliability initiatives, or cost optimization programs.
Exposure to high-scale consumer technology or social platforms with strong privacy, performance, or safety requirements.
Strong storytelling and presentation skills—especially with senior engineering or executive audiences.
Masters or PhD in a highly analytical field

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Program Manager (PM)
to lead and grow the DTRA Experimentation Lab (DEL) Program in Fort Belvoir, VA.
Serving as key personnel, the PM will provide overall program leadership and act as the primary integrator between the Leidos team and the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) Research and Development (RD) Directorate. The PM will ensure customer projects, service desk requests, and operational priorities are effectively tracked, coordinated, and completed on schedule while maintaining a high standard of customer service and mission support. This role requires the ability to translate evolving mission needs into executable technical and operational outcomes, communicate effectively with both technical personnel and senior nontechnical stakeholders, and coordinate across multiple DTRA customers, including the RD Directorate, DTRA J6, facilities stakeholders, and DTRA cybersecurity offices.

The PM will lead the program's technical approach, including day-to-day operations, infrastructure sustainment, cybersecurity coordination, and proactive modernization initiatives. Key focus areas include the adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), engineering-task automation, and other improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, security, and mission effectiveness. The PM will work closely with Leidos finance, contracts, and technical leadership to maintain appropriate staffing levels and execute within the established contract budget, as well as interacting with Leidos personnel for technical innovation, meeting the program's Performance Work Statement (PWS). Responsibilities include budget planning for appropriate staffing needs and oversight for software licenses, hardware, infrastructure, and anticipated travel requirements, as applicable.

The successful candidate will lead with credibility, accountability, sound technical judgment, and empathy. The PM will empower Leidos and partner personnel, enable government customers (DTRA and other performers), identify and manage program risks, and drive measurable outcomes while upholding trust, integrity, and mission focus. The role requires a steady and decisive leader who can provide clear recommendations, articulate the rationale behind financial, technical and security-related decisions, and maintain disciplined execution in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Salary Range: $125K to $165K

Program Summary

DTRA’s mission is to enable the Department of Defense (DoD), the Interagency, and International Partners to counter and deter Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and Improvised Threat Networks. The DEL’s mission is to serve as DTRA’s focal point for information technology (IT) integration, innovation, and collaboration, fostering customers’ mission, supporting cross-RD advanced R&D initiatives, maintaining awareness of and competence in trending technologies, and providing opportunities to leverage existing RD assets in support of operational and technical requirements.

Primary Responsibilities & Measures Of Success

Provide technically credible program leadership across DEL operations, architecture, cybersecurity, and modernization by identifying real risks, challenging incorrect assumptions, and protecting the networks from avoidable failures.

Measure of Success: Modernization and operational milestones are achieved on schedule and within contract and budget constraints, with no unplanned outages, security regressions, and with identified technical, contractual, and financial risks mitigated before they impact network or program performance.

Translate complex technical and operational realities into clear, actionable guidance for senior government and stakeholders to enable informed decision-making.

Measure of Success: Senior government and stakeholder decisions are made with clear understanding of technical risks, tradeoffs, and impacts, resulting in timely approvals, reduced rework or reversals, and demonstrably increased trust and engagement from DISA J6 leadership.

Identify, manage, and mitigate program risks (technical, operational, financial, contractual, and organizational) before they impact performance, cost, or credibility.

Measure of Success: Program risks across technical, operational, financial, contractual, and organizational domains are identified and mitigated early, resulting in stable execution with no avoidable cost growth, schedule slips, mission impacts, or loss of stakeholder confidence.

Elevate cybersecurity posture, ATO continuity, and risk governance by ensuring all modernization, migration, and engineering activities are planned and executed within RMF requirements, ATO constraints, and approved cyber risk tolerances, in close partnership with cyber and compliance leadership.

Measure of Success: The DEL team maintains continuous ATO authorization and cyber credibility throughout modernization and migration efforts, with POA&Ms and CORA findings proactively managed, no unplanned compliance-driven execution delays, and no mission impact resulting from unmanaged cyber or accreditation risk.

Build and sustain trusted relationships across Leidos, subcontractors, and government partners through integrity, consistency, accountability, and results.
Measure of Success: Leidos is viewed by government and industry partners as a reliable, mission-focused leader, evidenced by sustained customer confidence, effective collaboration across primes and subcontractors, and repeat engagement on complex or high-trust initiatives beyond baseline contract requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible, emotionally intelligent, ethically grounded PM who is calm under pressure, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and relentless about clarity and integrity. They lead through influence in environments with shared accountability and are comfortable making hard recommendations even when unpopular. They lead without ego, disagree without being disagreeable, and are willing to stand firm in support of the mission and the team.

Basic Qualifications

BA/BS or equivalent experience and 5+ years of prior relevant experience or master’s with 3+ years or prior relevant experience with autonomously guiding complex projects and operations across multiple related IT disciplines throughout the project lifecycle. Specific experience, education and training may be considered in lieu of degree.
2+ years of experience supervising or leading teams or projects.
Active DoW Secret level security clearance with ability to get Top Secret and be eligible for SCI at time of consideration.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the “single accountable voice” in contested environments.
Experience estimating technical and operations costs.
Experience identifying and assessing business impacts from proposed changes to a technical solution or enterprise operation.
Experience operating at Senior levels with accountability for enterprise outcomes.
Experience integrating subcontractor partners effectively into the mission.
Experience and ability to successfully negotiate and influence others to understand and accept new concepts, practices, and approaches.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations:
Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About The Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About The Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.
Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.
Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.
Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.
Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.
Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.

Experience presenting to clients and key-decision makers

Vision: Develop exceptional security professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
