AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Credence, we support our clients' mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for war-fighters and secure our nation for a better future. 
We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
Credence has an immediate opening for a Senior Program Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at WPAFB, OH. 
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 2000.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below

Assist in risk management, cost, schedule, and performance of various software development efforts in a program management role, and report on them monthly through use of the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT). 
Assist to interpret, organize, execute and coordinate assignments within the context of the Government acquisition process. 
Assist to explore software development and integration, definition of scope, and selection of problems for investigation. 
Support the program director at executive levels within the Government and other Contractor organizations, including major program reviews, inspections, conferences, and other program evaluations and major milestone events. 
Assist to establish and maintain contacts between the program office, supporting Government offices, other Contractors, and higher headquarters' mid-to upper-level staff. 
Assist with the analysis of war fighter requirements with ACC and serve as key advisor to F-16 Division leadership on mission-critical capability trades.

Our objective is to provide clients with a unique business perspective on how to leverage SAP technology to improve their operations. This is rooted in EY’s SAP service line capabilities (Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch and SuccessFactors) that are focused on helping clients improve performance and increase productivity.

The opportunity

EY's Agile Business Transformation enabled by SAP technology can help organizations address challenges in the digital era. Our EY SAP collaborative approach focuses on more than technology alone. We take a comprehensive, business-first view to address strategy, customer value, user experiences, processes, technology, and operational impacts in tandem.

In this role, you will interact with business stakeholders to evaluate business models, processes, and operations. You will gather, understand, and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. Additionally, you will analyze newly implemented technology solutions to ensure they meet business requirements and collaborate with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Manager in Technology Analysis, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering complex technical initiatives. You will face challenges that require innovative problem-solving and analytical skills, providing you with opportunities to grow and learn in a dynamic environment.

Lead workstream delivery and ensure effective management of processes and solutions.
Track deliverable completion and project status, ensuring alignment with performance objectives.
Actively participate in client working sessions, leading workstreams from planning through execution and closure.
Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and possess strong business acumen. Demonstrate ability to assimilate new knowledge.
Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels.
Facilitate requirement gathering and lead design workshops during explore, configuration, unit testing phases; document functional specifications for design gaps during build phase; assist the client in all testing cycles; deliver training prior to go-live; and provide post go-live support.
Stay current with the annual releases of new Asset Management (Plant Maintenance) functionalities from SAP.
Collaborate within a team across workstreams (procurement, project systems, finance, quality management, production, materials management, warehouse management, supply chain, and IBP) to design, test, and deploy SAP solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To thrive in this role, you will need a blend of technical and interpersonal skills. Your ability to build relationships and communicate effectively will be crucial in delivering exceptional client service.

On your typical engagement, you will work with the key stakeholders to understand their needs and advise on the SAP Asset Management system capabilities. You will initiate the requirement gathering, architect solutions, blueprinting, testing, complete the workflow and documentation, as well as the functional design of the solution. Liaise with the stakeholders and technical team to translate needs into business solutions and complete the configurations and/or integrations with SAP and non-SAP systems.

Strong analytical skills to develop solutions to complex problems.
Proven ability to manage engagement economics and resource planning.
Experience in leading teams and managing change effectively.
Ability to identify opportunities for additional services and lead specific RFP responses.

Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).
Typically, no less than 4 - 6 years’ relevant experience working with SAP Asset Management/Plant Maintenance (PM)/Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
Strong understanding of Asset Management principles and practices.
Experience managing an SAP project or workstream and project-based team members.
Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
Ability and comfort level researching client inquiries and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices, and new technologies.
A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Experience in managing client relationships and expectations.

jobs.title: Workday Financials Project Manager
jobs.description:
We Are

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate revenue growth, and enhance services. We combine our strength in technology with deep industry experience, functional expertise, and global delivery capabilities to help clients reinvent how they operate and create lasting value.

Our Workday practice helps clients transform finance, human resources, planning, payroll, and related enterprise processes through Workday strategy, implementation, optimization, and application managed services. Our teams bring together business, functional, technical, data, integration, change, and program leadership capabilities to deliver measurable outcomes.

You Are

A delivery-focused Workday Project Manager who can bring structure to complex programs, build trusted client relationships, and lead cross-functional teams toward clear outcomes. You understand that successful Workday delivery requires more than maintaining a plan. It requires proactive decision-making, disciplined governance, transparent risk management, commercial awareness, and the ability to keep business and technology stakeholders aligned.

You are comfortable operating with senior client leaders, Workday functional and technical teams, third parties, and global delivery teams. You communicate clearly, anticipate issues before they become obstacles, and create an environment where teams can deliver high-quality work with accountability and confidence.

The Work

Lead Workday implementation, deployment, optimization, or application managed services programs from mobilization through stabilization and transition.
Own the integrated delivery plan, including scope, schedule, milestones, dependencies, resources, budget, deliverables, and acceptance criteria.
Establish project governance, decision forums, status reporting, escalation paths, and documentation standards appropriate to the engagement.
Drive cross-functional coordination across Workday functional workstreams, integrations, data conversion, security, reporting, testing, change management, training, cutover, and deployment.
Partner with client sponsors and workstream leaders to clarify priorities, resolve decisions, manage expectations, and maintain alignment to business outcomes.
Maintain active management of risks, actions, issues, decisions, assumptions, and dependencies, with clear owners, target dates, and escalation when progress stalls.
Monitor delivery health and take timely corrective action to protect scope, schedule, quality, budget, and client satisfaction.
Lead project financial management, including forecasting, staffing, utilization, change control, commercial tracking, and variances against the approved plan.
Plan and facilitate executive steering committees, program leadership meetings, project status reviews, and working sessions that result in clear decisions and actions.
Coordinate release, testing, cutover, readiness, and go-live activities, including entry and exit criteria, command-center planning, and stabilization governance.
Ensure delivery methods, quality controls, security expectations, and contractual commitments are understood and followed across the project team.
Lead, coach, and develop project management team members while promoting collaboration, inclusion, accountability, and sustainable ways of working.
Build trusted relationships with clients, Workday, ecosystem partners, and internal stakeholders to support successful delivery and future opportunities.
Contribute to sales pursuits, solution shaping, estimates, delivery approaches, staffing plans, proposals, and transition from sales to delivery.
Capture lessons learned, reusable assets, and delivery insights that strengthen the Workday practice and improve future engagements.

Here’s What You Need

Minimum of 5 years of experience leading enterprise technology or business transformation initiatives, including responsibility for integrated project delivery.
Minimum of 3 years of experience managing Workday implementation, deployment, optimization, or support engagements.
Minimum of 3 years leading Workday deployment through planning, design, configuration, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
Experience managing cross-functional teams spanning functional, technical, integration, data, security, reporting, testing, and change disciplines.
Demonstrated experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and change control.
Experience with project financials, forecasting, staffing, and commercial management in a consulting or client-services environment.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associates Degree, must have minimum 6 years of work experience) helor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work exper(If Associates Degree, must have minimum 6 years of work experience)

Bonus Points If

Experience communicating with executive sponsors and translating detailed delivery information into concise, decision-oriented reporting.
Working knowledge of Workday implementation methods and lifecycle activities, including tenant strategy, testing cycles, data conversion, integrations, cutover, and production readiness.
Demonstrated experience managing project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and change control.
Experience communicating with executive sponsors and translating detailed delivery information into concise, decision-oriented reporting.
Experience with project financials, forecasting, staffing, and commercial ma
You have led large, multi-workstream, multi-country, or global Workday programs.
You have experience with Workday Human Capital Management, Financial Management, Payroll, Adaptive Planning, or cross-platform transformation programs.
You hold an active Workday certification or have completed Workday delivery training relevant to program or project leadership.
You hold a recognized project or agile credential, such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent certification.
You have experience recovering challenged programs or leading complex cutover and deployment activities.
You have external client-facing consulting experience and experience supporting sales pursuits or solution development.
You have experience leading distributed, offshore, or global delivery teams and third-party vendors.

What Success Looks Like

Clients have confidence in the plan, the team, and the accuracy of delivery reporting.
The project operates with clear ownership, timely decisions, controlled change, and visible management of delivery risk.
Cross-functional teams stay aligned to milestones and quality expectations while maintaining a collaborative working environment.
Engagement financials, staffing, and contractual commitments are actively managed and understood.
Go-live readiness is evidence-based, and transition to stabilization or support is planned and executed with minimal disruption.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Accenture is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and a work environment where individuals are treated with respect. Recruiting teams should include the approved country- and location-specific equal opportunity, accommodation, work authorization, and compensation language when the requisition is posted.

Benefits

Accenture offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. See more information on our benefits here:

jobs.title: Nationwide - Electronic Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth

i2G specializes in advanced physical electronic security and life safety solutions. I2G has proven experience in surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection systems, biometrics, fence sensors, radars, ground sensors, anti-drone technologies, and more. We excel in design, project management, commissioning, and enterprise technology integrations.

i2G’s mission is to provide the products and services that meet our customers’ needs to give them a vital advantage in today’s market, helping to protect what matters most.

We are seeking a Electronic Security Project Manager
to coordinate and execute physical security installations across client sites. In this role, you will take operational ownership of multiple projects simultaneously—ensuring deployments are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with client specifications.

Working alongside local engineering, sales, and technical teams, you will manage field crews (Senior/Lead Technicians, Junior Technicians) and subcontractors. You will be responsible for active site coordination, milestone tracking, material logistics, job profitability, and continuous stakeholder communication from kickoff through sign-off.

Applicants for this role must have Property Technology Security backgrounds!

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Schedule Tracking: Coordinate day-to-day operations for multiple concurrent security integration projects. Maintain project schedules, monitor progress against established baselines, track job costs, and mitigate delivery delays.
Field & Subcontractor Coordination: Supervise installation crews and specialized low-voltage subcontractors. Ensure field work complies with scopes of work (SOW), client quality standards, and OSHA/job-site safety regulations.
Site Verification & Readiness: Conduct pre-installation site walks to evaluate electrical, network, and pathway dependencies. Proactively identify site readiness issues or physical impediments, communicating risks promptly to stakeholders.
Technical Oversite: Review security system drawing sets, floor plans, riser diagrams, and basic civil/electrical prints. Work with integration engineers to ensure accurate programming and configuration of access control, video management, intrusion detection, and intercom systems.
Change Management & Financials: Track labor hours and project materials, manage inventory staging, and process red-line drawings. Identify out-of-scope work and collaborate with account teams to generate formal change orders
Commissioning & Punch List Closeout: Coordinate system testing, functional checkout, and client acceptance walks. Rapidly clear punch list items, collect final sign-offs, assemble closeout documentation, and assist with proposal estimations as needed.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in the electronic security, low-voltage, or commercial systems integration field, with at least 2–3 years in a project management or project coordination capacity.
Domain Focus: Prior experience within Property Technology (PropTech), commercial real estate, or enterprise electronic security environments
Technical Knowledge: Working familiarity with enterprise access control and video surveillance platforms such as LenelS2, Software House (C
CURE), Axis, Verint, Commend, DMP, or integrated fire/alarm panels. Factory certifications are a plus.
Software Tools: Working proficiency with MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams) and project management/scheduling platforms (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, SimPRO)
Industry Credentials: Certified Security Project Manager (CSPM) or PMP certification (or progress toward certification) is preferred but not required.
General Requirements: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record; ability to walk job sites and navigate active construction environments; must be able to pass a background check and drug screen.

Company Overview

This is am Electronic Security Project Manager career opportunity with i2G Systems. Learn more about i2G
: https://www.i2gsystems.com/careers.html

Ottimate operates in the AI-powered automation space, focusing on streamlining financial operations and spend management for businesses. The organization addresses challenges related to integrating financial workflows by providing a platform that connects with ERP, accounting, and procurement systems, enabling improved operational efficiency and scalability.

About the Opportunity:

The MANAGER, IMPLEMENTATION & ENABLEMENT leads the team responsible for transitioning customers from contract signing to realizing measurable value from the platform. This role emphasizes managing outcomes over timelines by defining successful implementation standards, developing consistent methodologies, and ensuring the team delivers customer value at scale. It serves as a key liaison across multiple functions to align customer expectations with delivered results and evolves in scope alongside organizational growth.

Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a team of Implementation Managers and Enablement Consultants with a focus on accountability and customer outcomes
Coach team members through feedback and skill development to enhance performance and growth
Establish clear expectations and performance standards for the team
Develop and maintain implementation methodology focused on outcome-driven delivery

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Lightfield

Lightfield is reimagining CRM as a world model of a business. By learning from emails, meetings, and customer conversations, we’re building a living understanding of how a company works—so AI can help teams anticipate what comes next, make better decisions, and take action.

More than 5,000 companies have used the product since its November launch. We’ve raised more than $70M from Andreessen Horowitz, Coatue, Maverick Ventures, and Greylock to attack the biggest software category in the world. We previously built Tome, which reached more than 25 million users, and our team brings experience from Llama, Instagram, Google, and Salesforce.

About The Role

We're hiring founding Deployment Strategists for our Growth & Delivery team.

The team deploys Lightfield for customers, delivers their pipeline generation motion, supports strategic deals alongside our leadership team, and drives special projects across GTM and business operations.

You'll work directly with founders and their teams to deploy Lightfield as the system their company runs on, build their customer memory, put agents to work generating pipeline, and help their business grow. The agents do the work—you bring the judgment and taste that guide them, and the advisory relationship with the customer.

You're both an operator and a builder: running many customer deployments at once, and turning what works into playbooks the whole team can run.

What you’ll do

Own each customer's deployment end to end: set up their workspace, migrate their data, build their customer memory, and enable their team, so Lightfield becomes the system their company runs on
Deliver pipeline generation for a portfolio of customers: understand each business, define the ICP and targeting strategy, and direct Lightfield's agents from first outreach to booked meetings
Advise founders and GTM leaders on their go-to-market and how to put AI agents to work in it
Own the outcomes: time-to-activation, meetings booked, and the quality of the pipeline behind them
Support strategic deals alongside our leadership team, from scoping POCs to helping convert evaluations into customers
Take on special projects across GTM and business operations, from business analysis to competitive research to new initiatives
Turn what works into playbooks, and feed what you learn back to product so the agents get better

Who you are

3+ years of experience in consulting, banking, investing, or go-to-market and operating roles
A strong generalist, comfortable across delivery, growth, and customer-facing work. You don't wait to be handed a lane and instead figure out what needs to happen and do it
A trusted advisor to founders and GTM leaders - curious and analytical, able to read a business and its customers quickly, move from qualitative signals to a clear hypothesis, and back your view with data.
A systems thinker who brings structure to open-ended problems and builds playbooks and repeatable processes, not just completed tasks
High agency and thrives in ambiguity, able to independently drive projects and deliver results in a fast-moving environment
Comfortable going technical: you can reason about data models and integrations, configure workflows, and tune how an agent behaves
You're excited about AI agents and the opportunity to deliver customer outcomes with them
Eager to learn GTM and outbound. Prior experience is a plus, not a prerequisite

Benefits & Perks

Competitive salary
Meaningful early equity
Health insurance (medical, dental, vision)
3 weeks of PTO
11 paid company holidays + we enjoy a winter holiday break
3 months of paid family leave
Wednesdays work from home
Regular team dinners, events, offsites, and retreats
401k plan
Other perks include: commuter and lunch stipend

jobs.location: Ort im Innkreis, Upper Austria, Austria
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Compensation Package

For candidates applying from Italy:

As part of our commitment to transparency, we want to share the compensation details for this position:

Applicable CBA: Metalmeccanico

Minimum annual salary: €53.000

Variable Pay: AIP target % + Eligible for Company Productivity Bonus

Country-specific benefits will be discussed with shortlisted candidates based on location.

The offer will be tailored based on your role location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.

Benefits As Per Policy

Flexible working hours, hybrid work options, and a strong focus on work-life integration and Wellbeing support for employees and their families

Welfare plan with a wide range of personalized services

Canteen or meal vouchers provided

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Position Overview: Eligibility Program Manager - Quality Assurance & Program Integrity

The Quality Assurance and Program Integrity (QA/PI) Program Manager plays a critical leadership role in ensuring program accuracy, compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement within the Department of Social Services. This position is responsible for overseeing the Quality Assurance and Program Integrity teams, including second-party case reviews, eligibility and policy compliance monitoring, error identification, and program integrity investigations. The Program Manager provides leadership, guidance, and support to staff while collaborating with program administrators, supervisors, and other departments to identify trends, address deficiencies, implement corrective actions, and strengthen overall program performance. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership, analytical and problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to interpret complex federal and state policies while promoting a culture of accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Key responsibilities include:

Overseeing quality assurance and program integrity activities for public assistance programs.
Monitoring compliance with federal, state, and county policies and procedures.
Reviewing case accuracy, identifying trends, and recommending corrective actions.
Guiding efforts to prevent, identify, and address improper payments and potential fraud.
Providing leadership, training, and technical guidance to staff.
Collaborating with program leaders to improve eligibility processes and service delivery.
Analyzing findings and preparing reports to support program improvements and accountability.

This role operates with a high degree of independent judgment and initiative within established guidelines and reports directly to the Customer Service Program Administrator.

General Definition of Work:

Performs advanced professional level responsible supervisory work in the guidance, coordination, and delivery of eligibility programs and services within a unit of the Economic and Family Support Services Division within the Department of Social Services. Work is circumscribed by federal, state, and county constraints, but within those constraints the employee exercises independent judgment and initiative. Work is performed under regular supervision of the Customer Service Program Administrator. Supervision is exercised over eligibility staff.

Examples of Duties

Essential Functions/Typical Tasks:

Plans, directs, supervises, and participates in the delivery of eligibility programs and services; reviews casework, holds conferences, and assists eligibility specialist staff in resolving difficult or unusual case situations; interprets and provides guidance on regulations and procedures; prepares and maintains records, files, reports, and confidentiality
.
(These are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work performed. The omission of specific duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.)
Supervises eligibility specialist staff and eligibility supervisors. Evaluates performance of staff for adherence to Federal and State standards regarding quality of work.
Provides recommendations for employment actions such as hiring, promotions, demotions, disciplinary actions, and dismissals.
Ensures supervisors are balancing workloads within their unit.
Evaluates and makes necessary adjustments in personnel assignments, staffing and organizational design for maximum efficiency.
Implements changes in work procedures or processes to meet program or service demands and client needs.
Presents recommendations to management regarding program or divisional goals, objectives, procedures, or processes.
Provides detailed analysis to management on administrative and/or budgetary issues.
Assess training needs and ensure appropriate training takes place.
Evaluates the work of the unit via quality assurance reports, State computer error printouts, and input from other supervisors and staff.
Enforces policies and procedures and ensures compliance.
Conducts team meetings and monthly conferences.
Supports and provides input on divisional and agency goals and objectives.
Participates in long-range planning for the division.
Prepares reports.
Maintains records, files, and confidentiality.
Performs duties related to disaster situations and emergency shelter operations.
Performs related tasks as required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Thorough knowledge of eligibility programs and required documentation. Considerable knowledge of the use of program manuals. Considerable knowledge of community services and programs that may affect eligibility. Considerable knowledge of and ability to read, analyze, interpret, and apply federal, state, and county program rules, regulations, and procedures. Considerable knowledge of casework supervision. Considerable knowledge of eligibility principles, techniques, and practices and their applications to casework. Working knowledge of office equipment, audiovisual equipment, computers, and applicable software. Ability to instruct, organize, supervise, and direct the work of subordinates. Ability to resolve conflict and provide mediation. Ability to tolerate high-stress situations. Ability to assess situations, extract the relevant information, and to make appropriate decisions. Ability to communicate and present ideas effectively verbally or in writing. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with staff, other supervisors, management, employees, and the general public.

Minimum Education / Experience requirements

Education and Experience:

Requires a high school diploma or equivalent. Requires four years of experience as an eligibility specialist or investigator in an eligibility program in North Carolina, preferably with at least one year of supervisory experience and or an equivalent combination of training and experience. Requires strong computer skills, particularly with programs such as Word and Excel. Ability to speak Spanish is desirable.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
MongoDB is seeking a Regulatory Change Management Program manager to help anticipate regulatory developments within Technology, Cyber Security and AI spaces, assess their implications for the business, and ensure material obligations are identified and addressed before they create unexpected risk or exposure. This role reports to the Director of Operations within MongoDB’s Assurance, Risk & Compliance (ARC) team.

You will monitor the regulatory environment, assess applicability and compliance impact, and give the ARC team a clear view of emerging obligations, exposure, and readiness. In addition to working within ARC, you will work across Privacy, Legal, Product, Engineering, People, and other business teams, providing the insight, interpretation, and escalation that help accountable owners respond early and proportionately.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

What you will do

Regulatory horizon scanning and change management

Monitor and triage developments in data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, digital resilience, artificial intelligence, online services, and other regulations relevant to MongoDB
Maintain a forward-looking regulatory change inventory, including source, effective date, applicability, affected business areas, accountable stakeholders, and current assessment status
Collaborate with legal to assess whether a regulatory development is relevant to MongoDB’s products, services, entities, customers, suppliers, workforce, or operating model
Prepare concise impact assessments, obligation summaries, briefing notes, and escalation papers for senior stakeholders within ARC group and Global Security Organization
Coordinate regulatory change assessments across subject-matter experts
Track decisions, dependencies, risks, and overdue responses; identify where ownership or interpretation is unclear
Surface emerging themes and potential blind spots

Data protection and Data classification

Collaborate with the Security team, the Privacy and Legal teams with GDPR and related data-protection analysis across products, business processes, and third-party relationships
Escalate potential compliance gaps, or unresolved interpretation questions
Help maintain and evolve a practical data-classification framework aligned to regulatory, security and business requirements
Advise teams from Compliance perspective on classification decisions for information used in internal systems, customer engagements, and third-party services
Review Compliance related classification challenges and exceptions for consistency, proportionality, and traceability

Oversight, reporting, and assurance

Develop dashboards and reporting that show exposure, readiness, ownership, overdue decisions, and material trends rather than activity for its own sake
Support internal compliance requests, regulatory enquiries, and control assessments by coordinating evidence and explaining the basis for conclusions
Contribute to policies, standards, playbooks, and training content where regulatory interpretation or risk context is required

What we are looking for

Five or more years of experience in regulatory change management in compliance, privacy, or a closely related discipline
Practical knowledge of data-protection principles, especially GDPR and UK GDPR, including lawful processing, accountability, data minimisation, transfers, retention, and individual rights
Exposure to DORA, NIS2, the EU AI Act, ePrivacy requirements, digital-services regulation, or comparable technology regulation
Experience working with in-house legal teams to interpret laws, regulations, regulatory guidance, or contractual requirements and translating them into obligations, applicability assessments, risks, and decisions
Experience supporting regulatory change management, horizon scanning, obligations management, or compliance impact assessments
Understanding of data classification, information governance, records management, or data-handling frameworks
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to distinguish material risk from noise and draw clear conclusions from incomplete information
Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to produce concise briefings, evidence-based recommendations, and documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
Strong stakeholder-management and collaboration skills, with the confidence to work across Legal, Privacy, Security, Engineering, Product, Procurement, People, and customer-facing teams
High attention to detail and strong organisational skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, dependencies, and follow-ups
A proactive, questioning mindset: you look for what could be missed, what has changed, who is affected, and what evidence would change the conclusion
Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgement, and escalate appropriately when ownership, applicability, or risk is unclear

Nice to have

Experience in a technology, SaaS, cloud, platform, or other highly regulated environment
Familiarity with information-security and assurance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, or the Cloud Security Alliance controls
Experience working with regulatory inventories, GRC platforms, privacy-management tools, data catalogues, or workflow systems
A relevant qualification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, IAPP FIP, CISA, CRISC, or an equivalent professional credential

What success looks like

Leaders receive early, decision-useful insight into regulatory developments that could affect MongoDB
Regulatory changes have a clear applicability assessment, accountable owner, documented rationale, and visible next step
Data-classification questions are answered consistently, with uncertainty and residual risk made explicit
The organisation can distinguish between a confirmed obligation, an interpretation requiring legal advice, an implementation task, and an unresolved risk
Audits, customer reviews, and regulatory conversations are supported by current evidence and a clear explanation of how conclusions were reached
Teams are less likely to be surprised by new obligations, missed dependencies, unclear ownership, or unsupported compliance claims

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Analyst, Customer Success
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to make an impact at an extraordinary scale.

About The Team

The Customer Success (CS) team oversees the post-sales lifecycle for Stripe users, helping them realise the full value of their investment in Stripe. CSMs drive user success, increase retention and expansion, and support mutually beneficial renewals. Few teams have such a direct impact on Stripe’s growth.

The CS Strategy and Operations (S&O) team shapes how Customer Success operates at Stripe, providing strategic and operational partnership to CS leadership. The team runs and improves both the function’s day-to-day operating model, from leadership forums and territory and compensation design to the systems and cadences that enable execution, and its long-term direction.

In this analyst role, you will help the team scale by surfacing insights for leaders, automating processes, building dashboards, and driving run-the-business operations. You will translate CS priorities into actionable plans, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build the operating mechanisms that help teams make better decisions, execute consistently, and scale effectively.

What you’ll do

The near-term focus of this role is to strengthen the operational foundations of Stripe’s Customer Success business. You will work on projects spanning process design, business cadences, systems, reporting and territory management, helping the team operate effectively as it scales.

As an analyst, you will turn data into actionable insights, measure and forecast business performance, and build dashboards that enable better decision-making. You will also identify opportunities to improve how the team works and partner across functions to design and implement scalable solutions.

Responsibilities

Partner cross-functionally to identify, analyse and resolve systems and operational challenges
Investigate system performance, operational workflows and underlying process issues
Measure and forecast business performance, surfacing insights and recommendations to CS leadership
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports that meet key business and leadership requirements
Manage CSM territories and support improvements to territory design and planning
Design and improve business processes using data and operational insights
Define, track and report on annual and quarterly objectives and key results (OKRs)
Prepare clear, decision-focused materials for quarterly business reviews (QBRs) and other leadership forums

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5-6 years of operations experience in a software solutions or technology company.
3+ years working with a GTM or Sales organization.
Data Analytics (SQL, creating/running complex queries and building dashboards)
Business and operational SLA reporting.
Communicate clearly, proactively, and concisely.
Self-starter and comfortable dealing with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

Tableau or SFDC report development experience.
Experience as a User and Report developer in SFDC

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is £67,500 - £101,300. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

The product operations analyst is responsible for analyzing and optimizing the operational performance of the products and services. This role focuses on collecting and interpreting operational data, identifying opportunities for process improvements, creates presentations and ensuring the products and services comply with all relevant regulations and industry standards. The product operational analyst works closely with cross-functional teams to enhance the efficiency, reliability, and customer experience of the product offerings.

The primary purpose of the product operations analyst is to provide data-driven insights and recommendations to the product management team, enabling them to make informed decisions that optimize the operational performance of the utility's products and services.

Operational Data Collection And Analysis

Gather and analyze operational data related to the products and services, such as usage patterns, service reliability, maintenance activities, and resource utilization.

Process Optimization

Evaluate the efficiency and effectiveness of the operational processes supporting the utility's products and services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement process improvements that enhance product performance, customer experience, and regulatory compliance.

Comprehensive inventory management, lifecycle optimization, utilization analysis, cost control, risk mitigation, compliance adherence, and data-driven reporting to support effective product asset management and strategic decision-making.
Analyze the utilization and allocation of resources (e.g., personnel, equipment, infrastructure) required to support the utility's product operations.
Provide recommendations on resource optimization to ensure efficient and cost-effective product delivery.

Identify and address any operational issues that may impact regulatory compliance.

Collaborate with the product management and operations teams and/or 3rd party vendors to implement corrective actions and prevent future occurrences.

Develop and maintain operational performance dashboards and reports for the product management team and other stakeholders.
Provide insights and recommendations based on the analysis of operational data.

Communicate findings and recommendations and create presentations effectively to various stakeholders, including senior management.

jobs.description:
BBB National Programs

BBB National Programs is where businesses turn to enhance consumer trust and consumers are heard.

Business Development Program Analyst

**This role requires a minimum of three in-office days per week in McLean, VA to perform the essential functions of the position.

WHO WE ARE

We are a non-profit organization dedicated to fostering a more accountable and trustworthy marketplace. As the foremost thought leader on industry self-regulation, we are shaping the way that businesses and consumers interact with one another. As the home of U.S. independent industry self-regulation, we are currently operating more than twenty globally recognized programs that have been helping enhance consumer trust in business for more than 50 years. Our programs provide third-party accountability and dispute resolution services that address existing and emerging industry issues, create a fairer playing field for businesses, and a better experience for consumers. We continue to evolve our work and grow our impact by providing business guidance and fostering best practices in areas such as advertising, child-and-teen-directed marketing, data privacy, dispute resolution, automobile warranty, technology, and emerging areas.

ABOUT OUR NATIONAL PARTNERS

BBB National Programs National Partners influence the future of regulation in their industry, demonstrating to stakeholders their commitment to accountable, industry-led standards and dispute resolution programs that protect consumers and keep the playing field level for business. National Partners are champions of industry self-regulation, data privacy, consumer protection, and truth and accuracy in advertising, and support our work as the leading voice for industry self-regulation.

YOUR IMPACT

The Business Development Program Analyst turns data and research into insight that drives National Partner growth, retention, and sponsorship strategy. Working directly with the Vice President and partnering with Directors and Managers across the Business Development and National Partner team, this role is central to the successful execution of membership growth, partner engagement, and sponsorship initiatives.
The analyst owns the team’s data, research, and reporting—ensuring CRM integrity, uncovering and prioritizing new opportunities, and translating findings into clear recommendations for leadership. This role requires an analytical, detail-oriented, and proactive individual who is comfortable working independently while collaborating across multiple stakeholders.
The ideal candidate is curious, resourceful, and eager to learn, with strong research and analytical capabilities and a desire to contribute to business development and membership growth efforts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
CRM, Data & Reporting

Own the accuracy and integrity of data within the CRM system
Perform regular data audits, cleanup, and enrichment to support effective outreach and reporting
Build and maintain weekly and ad hoc reports and dashboards to support membership, retention, and business development activities
Serve as a CRM resource for the team, including onboarding and training support for new users

Market & Prospect Research

Conduct in-depth research to identify prospective National Partners, sponsors, and key industry contacts
Build and maintain prospect lists, including detailed profiles of organizations and decision-makers
Segment target industries and organizations to identify trends and prioritize opportunities aligned with growth strategy
Demonstrate curiosity and initiative in uncovering new opportunities and insights

Pipeline & Performance Analysis (approx. 20%)

Analyze National Partner acquisition, renewal, and retention trends, and flag at-risk partners
Track pipeline performance, including conversion rates, win rates, and revenue forecasts
Measure the effectiveness of outreach and digital campaigns related to partner and sponsor acquisition, and recommend adjustments
Assess sponsorship and event ROI and National Partner engagement levels
Translate findings into concise briefs, presentations, and recommendations for leadership

Outreach & Proposal Support

Execute targeted outreach campaigns, including email communications and follow-ups
Draft proposals, pitch materials, and customized outreach content informed by prospect research
Track outreach activities and engagement metrics within the CRM

Partner Engagement & Events

Support engagement activities and communications for existing National Partners
Coordinate onboarding for new National Partners
Use engagement data to identify opportunities to strengthen partner relationships
Support planning and execution of events and sponsorships, including pre-event materials and on-site coordination as needed
Identify and research sponsorship prospects

Team Operations

Coordinate team workflows, track priorities, and ensure timely follow-up on key initiatives
Prepare briefing materials for leadership meetings and external engagements, and capture action items

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Must have:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
1-3 years of relevant professional experience
Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
Strong research and analytical capabilities, with a track record of turning data and research into actionable recommendations
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
Advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, data cleanup) and proficiency in Word and PowerPoint
Experience with CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics), including building reports

Let us know if you have:

Experience in a nonprofit, membership-based, or professional services environment
Exposure to business development, sales, or partnership support functions
Experience supporting senior leadership
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
Familiarity with prospecting tools (e.g., LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo)
Experience using AI tools to support research and analysis

WHAT WE OFFER:

At BBB National Programs, we bring a growth mindset as we advance our mission and strive to foster trust, innovation, and competition in the marketplace, while cultivating a team of talented and engaged professionals who seek out new challenges and opportunities to catalyze our progress. We are an inclusive organization, bringing a dynamic environment that supports our employees and the meaningful work we do.

Wellness

Environment

Description

Amazon’s Global Procurement Organization is transforming how procurement operates at Amazon scale, and we are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive that transformation. This role owns the programs that move procurement from individual AI-assisted productivity toward an operating model where AI agents carry processes end to end and people verify, orchestrate, and govern. It sits at the intersection of technology, business process redesign, and organizational change, where your work shapes not just the tools procurement uses but how the work itself is structured.

Key job responsibilities

Define and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of complex, cross-functional technology programs, from problem definition and design through build, launch, and iteration.
Stand up and operate new delivery team structures for AI transformation initiatives, from team charter and composition through to solutions running in production.
Define how transformation success is measured and establish baselines before changes land, so that claimed gains can be verified rather than argued.
Design and run program decision gates, including the criteria for continuing or stopping an initiative, the evidence required at each gate, and the escalation path when something is not working.
Partner with business leaders to redesign processes, targeting the coordination effort that becomes unnecessary once supplier, commercial, risk, and policy information is maintained as a shared capability.
Drive architecture and design discussions, applying working knowledge of AI and AWS services to evaluate trade-offs and ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and operationally sound.
Build the mechanisms the program depends on, including team and charter registries, playbooks for standing up new teams, and the feedback loop that carries learning between business areas.
Independently identify and resolve structural blockers across teams, including governance gaps, duplicated solutions, missing orchestration between existing tools, and unclear ownership.
Manage program roadmaps, milestones, and dependencies across multiple engineering teams, proactively identifying risks and removing barriers to keep delivery on track.
Facilitate business and technical meetings, driving crisp decisions and ensuring the right people are in the room at the right time.
Communicate program status, risks, trade-offs, and outcomes to stakeholders from engineering teams through Directors and VPs, in clear written narratives and verbal updates.

About The Team

Global Procurement Technology builds the systems behind Amazon’s procurement function, from how suppliers are brought on and assessed to how commercial terms, risk signals, and policy are applied across the company. We set the technology strategy for the business and lead its AI transformation, embedding intelligent automation and data-driven capability into the procurement experience rather than layering tools on top of unchanged processes.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures, and can hold their own in design reviews and technical deep dives. You have a strong grasp of AI and machine learning technologies and understand how to apply them to solve real-world operational problems. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, bringing structure and clarity where none exists, and you have a bias for action that keeps programs moving forward. Above all, you are customer-obsessed, always working backwards from the needs of the business and the end user.

Basic Qualifications

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
2+ years of software development experience
4+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
Bachelor's degree
Experience working with AI systems, including large language models and agent-based workflows, strong enough to assess feasibility and challenge proposed designs

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Experience leading highly technical programs involving infrastructure, complex systems, systems engineering

jobs.title: Agile Project Manager
jobs.description:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

Summary

Avetta is evolving beyond traditional Agile and SAFe delivery frameworks into an AI-Augmented Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC) a structured pipeline where AI agents assist at every stage, from product discovery through to production release, while humans retain ownership of every key decision.

As an Agile Project Manager (APM)
in the AI-PDLC, you are the connective tissue of that pipeline. You don't just track progress, but you ensure the right human judgment is applied at the right gates, so AI-generated work meets Avetta's quality bar before it moves forward.

This role is ideal for a mid-level Agile delivery professional who is confident running cross-functional initiatives, comfortable working directly with product and engineering pod teams, and genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping software delivery.

Candidates residing within 30 miles of an Avetta office are required to follow a hybrid work schedule of three days in the office and two days working from home each week. Candidates residing more than 30 miles from an Avetta office may be considered for remote employment.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Pipeline Coordination & Flow Management
Own end-to-end delivery flow for one or more initiatives across Avetta's 5-zone AI-PDLC pipeline — from validated discovery through to production release.

Track initiative progress using the 3 Red Box milestone model (pipeline entry → approved spec → production), with cycle time and throughput as primary delivery metrics.

Coordinate zone-to-zone handoffs, ensuring the right sign-offs are in place before any AI-generated artifact like spec, task breakdown, or code advances downstream.

Facilitate the Spec Agreement gate: the checkpoint where both the Product Manager and Tech Lead confirm intent and approach before AI-assisted coding begins.

Maintain the Gate Decision Log in Confluence for each initiative: what was reviewed, what was decided, and what changed: the audit trail proving human judgment drove every step.

Flag missing or incomplete dependencies (such as the SDAP coding rulebook) early; no AI coding work moves forward without them.
Cross-Pod Dependency Orchestration

Coordinate across 3–5 person delivery pods, acting as the integration point for work spanning multiple teams, domains, or codebases.

Facilitate cross-pod syncs focused on AI pipeline blockers, spec quality issues, and zone-to-zone handoff readiness, replacing traditional Scrum of Scrums.

Own RAID and decision logs at the initiative level, with specific attention to AI pipeline failure modes such as unresolved spec questions and AI output drift.

Partner with Scrum Masters to surface and escalate pod-level blockers before they become pipeline bottlenecks.
Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as the primary communication point between Product Management, engineering pod leads, Release Management, and senior stakeholders for initiative status, risks, and key decisions.

Prepare concise, data-driven updates for monthly C-level reporting, structured around pipeline volume, spec approval rate, and production throughput.

Communicate spec quality issues and AI agent output concerns clearly, with proposed mitigations not just escalation.

Help PMs set stakeholder expectations around AI-PDLC timelines, which may differ from traditional Agile estimates.
Spec Quality & Gate Integrity

Apply the Spec Rubric (a pass/fail quality checklist) at the approved-spec gate to ensure no work is greenlighted below the agreed quality standard.

Surface and report spec rejection patterns as early-warning signals — high rejection rates predict downstream delivery slowdowns.

Ensure Definition of Ready criteria are met before any initiative enters the delivery zone.

Track open spec questions across initiatives and ensure they are resolved — not bypassed.
Tooling, Metrics & Continuous Improvement

Maintain delivery data in Jira, Aha!, and Confluence aligned to the AI-PDLC pipeline; log gate timestamps accurately for cycle time reporting.

Build and maintain dashboards tracking key metrics: cycle time, throughput, spec rejection rate, PR review cycles, and human gate hours per initiative.

Use AI productivity tools (Glean, Claude, Jira automation/Scriptrunner/Atlassian Intelligence) to reduce manual tracking overhead and surface blockers proactively.

Coach pod teams and stakeholders on AI-PDLC process expectations, HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) gate responsibilities, and how to engage productively with AI agents.

Champion the principle: “The AI generates artifacts; humans own decisions.”

Contribute improvement observations back into the AI-PDLC framework: this is a living system and your insights matter.

Ideal Experience, Education & Training

Experience
3–5 years in Agile delivery, project management, or program coordination in a SaaS or software environment.

Hands-on experience with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, QA, Design).

Background in organizations undergoing Agile or technology transformation; AI-augmented delivery experience is a strong plus.
Agile & AI-PDLC Skills

Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks with ability to adapt ceremonies to AI-augmented team models.

Familiarity with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) — understanding that input spec quality directly drives AI output quality.

Working knowledge of human-in-the-loop (HITL) gate concepts and the distinction between AI-generated artifacts and human-owned decisions.
Tools

Proficiency with Jira, Scriptrunner, Confluence, and Aha! for initiative tracking, gate logging, and reporting.

Experience with AI productivity tools (Atlassian Intelligence, Glean, Claude, or equivalent).

Comfortable with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint for distributed team collaboration.
Soft Skills

Strong written and verbal communication: able to translate AI pipeline status into clear, business-relevant updates for any audience.

High judgment and organizational discipline; able to manage multiple initiative workstreams without losing sight of gate integrity.

Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable influencing without direct authority.

Change-agent mindset with genuine openness to rapid iteration as the AI-PDLC framework matures.
Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience in Agile delivery or program coordination roles.
Certifications (Preferred, Not Required)

SAFe and AI fluency credentials (SAFe (SA / SSM / SASM / SPC), AWS AI Practitioner, Google AI Essentials) are weighted above traditional PM certifications (CSM / PSM I–II, CAPM / PMP for this role.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager II/Senior, Real World Evidence/ Late Phase Research
new_jobs.description:
About CTI

CTI Clinical Trial and Consulting Services is a global, privately held, full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) focused on the advancement of treatments for chronically and critically ill patient populations. We assist clinical research throughout the lifecycle of development, from drug concept to commercialization. CTI is headquartered in the Greater Cincinnati, OH region with global operations in collaboration with pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device firms. For more information, visit www.ctifacts.com

Job Purpose/ Summary:
Responsible for overseeing and coordinating all operational aspects of Real World Evidence (RWE) clinical studies and projects according to contract ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction from planning to completion. Manage and represent assigned functional study team members in RWE studies and projects.

What You'll Do:

Oversee and manage RWE clinical studies and other clinical projects. RWE clinical studies include, but are not limited to: Disease or drug registries, Natural History of Disease studies, Post-marketing required studies, Decentralized trials, Pragmatic trials, Long term follow-up studies, Retrospective studies, Early Access Programs (EAP’s), Other clinical programs primarily observational or low-interventional in design
Other areas of oversight and coordination could include, but are not limited to the following project types, in conjunction with research scientists: Systematic Literature Reviews and Meta Analyses, Database analyses, Development of Economic models, Oversight of advisory boards, surveys and feasibility assessments, Additional medical writing activities (protocols, clinical study reports, abstracts, manuscripts, posters and white papers)
Manage multi-functional study teams throughout the study or project from kick-off through close-out. Responsible for ensuring all functional areas study team members deliver in a timely manner, on budget and with high quality throughout the duration of the study. Responsible for escalation of potential issues to leadership, as necessary.
Assist in study resourcing needs with other functional areas, when needed. Ensure proper transition with any new study team members throughout the study.
Work closely with the client and team to initiate study start-up and kick off. Organize and lead study kick-off meetings and ongoing client meetings throughout the duration of the study or project.
Develop timelines, trackers, project management plans and provide oversight for other key functional plans to ensure they are developed, reviewed and approved by the client, based on study scope.
Monitor for potential issues and risks throughout the study, quickly identify and escalate to leadership as needed, brainstorm solutions to present to the study team and client.
Prepare or oversee development, review, and finalization of deliverables for clients and senior management. Provide project status reports to client and management.
Manage timelines and budgets, collaborating with finance and leadership to ensure project remains on time and in budget. Conduct regular reviews of the budget and scope, including revenue recognition and approval of milestone payments. When needed, initiate out of scope notifications to clients.
Ensure training and utilization of various systems to support RWE programs, including but not limited to CTMS, eTMF, data systems, Smart Sheet and any others requested by clients.
Interact with multidisciplinary departments.
Develop project-specific operating procedures (PSOPs), as necessary, with responsible functional areas
Assist in the development and leadership of presentations at client and Investigator Meetings, including bid defense meetings.
Provide day-to-day oversight of CRA tasks on assigned projects when a lead CRA is not assigned.

What You'll Bring:

Bachelor’s Degree or above in a health science field, epidemiology, public health, pharmaceutical or medical device research, or related health science field
5 years real world evidence, clinical or business background in drug or device research/development, biotechnology, pharmaceutical or clinical research and/or combination of education & experience
Experience with real world evidence, drug development process and/or medical writing preferred
Experience in the oversight of Monitoring activities preferred

Why CTI?

Advance Your Career – We invest in your professional growth. Through a structured mentoring program, leadership development courses, and access to ongoing education and training opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, you’ll have the tools to achieve your goals. Our dedicated training department supports your successful career at CTI.
Be Part of an Award-Winning Team – Join a global team spanning 60 countries, recognized for its award-winning culture that prioritizes people. We support your work-life balance with generous health benefits, vacation packages, hybrid work opportunities, and paid parental leave. Through our CTI Cares program, you’ll have opportunities to give back to your community and the world.
Make a Lasting Impact – At CTI, your work directly contributes to advancing medicine. You’ll play a vital role in developing life-changing treatments for patients with chronic and critical illnesses. Together, we move medicine forward, making a difference for those who need it most.

Important Note

In light of recent increase in hiring scams, if you're selected to move onto the next phase of our hiring process, a member of our team will reach out to you directly from an @ctifacts.com
email address to guide you through our interview process. Please ensure you are applying for jobs directly on our website (www.ctifacts.com) or from our verified LinkedIn page.

Please Note

We will never communicate with you via Microsoft Teams or text message
We will never ask for your bank account information at any point during the recruitment process

Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.
