Title: Senior Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations

Reports to:
Senior Director, Project Management

Position Overview

The Senior Project Manager, PM Strategy and Operations is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading high-impact internal projects and strategic initiatives across the IMC Project Management organization. This role partners with Project Management leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive operational excellence, support commercial and business development activities, provide financial reporting and analysis, and lead integration and process improvement initiatives. The Senior Project Manager serves as an internal subject-matter expert, using strong project management, analytical, and influencing skills to translate business priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Business Development Support

Support commercial activities including RFPs, RFIs, proposal development, and budget reviews.
Provide Project Management and operational expertise to help ensure proposed solutions, budgets, assumptions, timelines, and resource requirements are operationally sound.
Partner with Business Development, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to support opportunity planning and proposal development.
Identify operational, financial, resource, and execution risks and recommend appropriate solutions.
Support internal preparation for bid defenses, capability presentations, and other Business Development activities.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

Developing and facilitating regular Project Profitability processes and governance.
Support financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and analysis across the Project Management organization.
Analyze financial and operational performance to identify trends, variances, risks, and opportunities.
Partner with Finance and Project Management leadership to investigate variances and support development of appropriate action plans.
Evaluate the financial impact of operational decisions and provide actionable insights to support leadership decision-making.
Support continuous improvement of financial reporting, forecasting accuracy, and financial visibility.

Strategic Project Management & Operational Excellence

Lead and coordinate complex internal projects and strategic initiatives, establishing clear plans, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and accountabilities.
Support integration, organizational change, and other cross-functional initiatives impacting Project Management.
Lead and support process improvement activities focused on increasing efficiency, consistency, standardization, and operational effectiveness.
Develop and implement improved workflows, tools, processes, and ways of working in partnership with key stakeholders.
Provide support as requested with clear reporting, analysis, recommendations, and visibility to progress, risks, and outcomes.
Other ad hoc support requests from Sr. Director, Project Management

Qualifications

Experience with financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.

Advanced to expert proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, complex formulas, data validation and analysis, financial and resource tracking, forecasting, and development of project-level and portfolio-level reporting.
Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to influence and drive results across functions without formal reporting authority.
Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.
Project management certification, such as PMP, preferred.

Key Competencies

Strategic project management
Financial and business acumen
Commercial and Business Development support
Data analysis and performance reporting
Process improvement and operational excellence
Integration and change management
Cross-functional leadership and influence
Risk management and problem solving
Executive-level communication

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands OR Germany - Remote

Travel:
up to 40% within DACH, Benelux, Nordics (an other European countries as needed)

Director, Professional Services, EMEA

Your Impact

In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, working with some of the most advanced technologies in the industry, including cloud and on-prem platforms, and mission-critical systems. You’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with brilliant minds across professional services, sales, engineering, product, and customer teams to deliver solutions that save lives and enhance public trust.

At Axon, we’re driven by a powerful mission: to protect life, capture truth, and accelerate justice. We’re growing rapidly, and this is your chance to make a lasting impact at a company where innovation meets purpose.

Program & Project Management

Manage all aspects of complex enterprise-grade product deployments
Oversee project milestones, resource planning, scope, timeline, and risk management.
Manage cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and on-time delivery.
Ensures project milestones and deadlines are met and associated documentation supports customer acceptance for purposes of revenue recognition
Support pre-sales scoping and post-sales implementation handoff.

Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to manage change requests, solution feasibility, and roadmap alignment.

Contribute to internal SOPs, implementation playbooks, and best practices.

What You Bring

Fluency in both German and English
European citizenship is required in order to work with sensitive Government data, willing to undergo a security check
5+ years of experience leading and delivering highly complex programs, with demonstrated success in technical program management.
Proven track record of managing enterprise-level software deployments, infrastructure projects, or large-scale enterprise application programs.
Deep expertise in delivering complex projects involving cross-functional teams, including sales, engineering, and product.

Experience gathering requirements, optimizing workflows, and facilitating change management within teams.
Familiarity with software configurations and coding experience (particularly JSON) preferred.
Advanced communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill technical concepts for diverse audiences.
Proficiency in guiding client and internal teams through ambiguity, driving alignment, and executing on shared goals.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

new_jobs.description:
Why IPS?

If you're searching for a place where you can grow, continue learning, and make a meaningful impact while still having time for the people and moments that matter most, welcome to Integrated Power Services! We believe your value extends far beyond your job title because the best work comes from people who feel supported, challenged, and fulfilled both professionally and personally. Here, you'll find opportunities to develop your career, work alongside exceptional teammates, and be part of a culture that recognizes that your life is worth just as much as your work—if not more. Because when people thrive, businesses thrive. If that sounds like the kind of place you've been looking for, we invite you to join us!

Benefits

Paid Time Off (PTO)
401k Employer Match
Bonus Incentives
Extensive Training & Career Development Programs
Tuition Reimbursement Program
Medical, Dental and Vision plans
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
And more!

This is a remote, territory-based role supporting customers throughout Florida. Regular travel within the region is required.

Responsibilities & Expectations

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful execution of PowerGuard projects from order handoff through final completion and closeout. This position serves as the primary point of coordination between the customer, sales, operations, service, suppliers, subcontractors, and other internal teams.

The Project Manager will take ownership of project schedules, communication, documentation, financial performance, equipment and material coordination, and issue resolution. The goal of this role is to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within scope and budget, while providing our customers with a high level of communication and service.

Manage assigned projects from sales handoff through completion, invoicing, and project closeout.
Review project scope, specifications, proposals, purchase orders, contracts, equipment requirements, and customer expectations at project kickoff.
Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, deliverables, and required customer commitments.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution and provide regular, proactive status updates.
Coordinate equipment, materials, subcontractors, freight, site requirements, startup, commissioning, and other project activities.
Work closely with PowerGuard sales, service, operations, purchasing, and administrative teams to ensure projects move forward without unnecessary delays.
Monitor project costs, revenue, gross margin, change orders, billing milestones, and overall financial performance.
Identify potential scope changes and ensure change orders are properly documented and approved before additional work is performed.
Identify project risks or delays early and develop action plans to keep projects on schedule.
Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers regarding equipment availability, documentation, technical requirements, and delivery schedules.
Conduct regular project reviews and maintain accurate project documentation, correspondence, schedules, and customer commitments.
Escalate significant technical, commercial, scheduling, or customer issues when additional support is required.
Coordinate project turnover to the appropriate service/support teams upon completion.
Ensure final documentation, customer acceptance, invoicing requirements, and closeout activities are completed promptly.
Support continuous improvement of PowerGuard’s project management processes and customer experience.

Qualifications And Competencies

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, construction management, project management, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant industry experience will be considered.
Prior project management experience in power generation, electrical equipment, construction, industrial services, mechanical/electrical contracting, or a related technical industry preferred.
Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously with responsibility for schedule, cost, customer communication, and execution.
Strong financial understanding, including project budgets, revenue, margin, cost tracking, forecasting, and change-order management.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage changing priorities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively across sales, operations, service, purchasing, finance, customers, suppliers, and subcontractors.
Comfortable holding internal and external stakeholders accountable for project commitments and deadlines.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project/business management systems.
Experience with standby and distributed power generation systems, including generator sets, automatic transfer switches, switchgear, paralleling equipment, and associated electrical/mechanical systems preferred,
Experience working with generator manufacturers, electrical contractors, general contractors, consulting engineers, and end users preferred.
Familiarity with Rehlko/Kohler or other major power-generation equipment is a plus.
PMP certification or formal project-management training is a plus but not required.

You’ll thrive at IPS if you…

Lead with integrity and prioritize safety. You demonstrate high standards and commit to a safe, ethical workplace.
Value teamwork and accountability. You work well with others, take responsibility, serve others, and deliver on your commitments.
Focus on the customer. You are dedicated to providing an unmatched customer experience and exceeding expectations.
Have an entrepreneurial spirit. You’re proactive, innovative, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Communicate effectively and with purpose. You keep everyone informed with clear, concise communication.
Stay curious and love to learn. You continuously seek new knowledge and grow personally and professionally.

Who We Are

At IPS, we're committed to empowering you to make a meaningful impact. As the industry's leading and fastest-growing service provider, IPS offers single-source electromechanical and power management solutions to enhance the reliability of critical infrastructure across North America and the United Kingdom. We serve over 40,000 essential customer locations, from renewable energy pioneers to hospitals, manufacturers, and municipalities, helping them avoid costly downtime and ensure mission-critical operations.

When you join IPS, you're joining a team that's revolutionizing equipment and process reliability across diverse sectors, from power generation to petrochemicals, and beyond. You'll learn from industry experts, grow alongside a talented workforce, and be part of a company that is built on the Shared Values of Safety, Integrity, Teamwork, Accountability, Customer Focus, and Entrepreneurial Spirit.

IPS is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

Any offer of employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background and driving record investigation. As a federal contractor, our company is committed to maintaining a safe and drug-free workplace. Candidates for this position are required to complete a pre-employment drug screen successfully. The drug screening process will include testing for substances that may impair one's ability to perform the job safely and effectively.

About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

About The Role

Code Metal is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex initiatives across a growing engineering organization. In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Solutions to advance Code Metal’s AI-powered code translation and verification platform.

You will work closely with technical and product leaders to translate strategic priorities into coordinated engineering programs, guide initiatives through the development lifecycle, and support successful end-to-end delivery. This role calls for technical fluency and the ability to navigate complex dependencies and tradeoffs while balancing near-term execution with long-term product and platform goals.

As the organization grows, you will also have the opportunity to shape how engineering programs are planned, executed, and scaled, helping build the foundation for continued innovation and product growth.

Core Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end execution of complex technical programs spanning research, engineering, infrastructure, and product development.

Develop and manage integrated execution plans, proactively addressing dependencies, risks, and shifting priorities.
Collaborate with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and tradeoffs, and help drive timely decisions across workstreams.
Define and track program metrics in partnership with teams, measuring progress, product quality, and technical readiness to inform decisions and improvements.

Communicate program progress, risks, and key decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations:
Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About The Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About The Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.
Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.
Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.
Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.
Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.
Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.
Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.
Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.
Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.
Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.
Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.
Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.
Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.
Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.
Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.
Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.
Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.
Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.
Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.
Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).
Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.
Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.
Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.
Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.
Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.
Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $189,000
For New York, Washington DC, Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000
For Austin Texas based hires: Estimated annual salary of $108,000 - $149,000

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

new_jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

At Snap, the Technical Program Manager (TPM) is not a traditional project coordinator—this is a strategic, high-leverage leadership role designed for deep technical operators who thrive at the intersection of software engineering, data analytics, and program execution. TPMs at Snap are single-threaded owners of large-scale, high-stakes, and often ambiguous programs. They combine engineering depth with execution precision, earning visibility and trust across the company by driving outcomes that power the core of our products and infrastructure. Unlike industry-standard TPM roles, Snap TPMs are hands-on contributors who write Python notebooks, build dashboards and automation tools, and partner closely with engineering leaders to shape technical roadmaps, make architectural trade-offs, and drive the operating rhythm of the business. The most successful TPMs possess the ability to grasp new concepts quickly, navigate technical complexity, and adapt in fast-moving environments. This role is ideal for former engineers or data scientists who have evolved into program leaders without leaving their technical roots behind.

Our interview process reflects the technical rigor and strategic impact expected of TPMs at Snap. Unlike typical program management interviews, our process is designed to evaluate candidates’ ability to think like engineers and act like owners. Candidates begin with a technical screen with the hiring manager that dives into core program execution and engineering fundamentals. From there, The final stage is a virtual onsite, which includes a program leadership presentation and four 1:1 interviews with senior leaders across Snap. Throughout, we assess not only communication and collaboration skills but also technical fluency, first-principles thinking, and the ability to drive strategic outcomes in complex, ambiguous environments.

As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) at Snap, you will:

Lead complex, cross-functional programs that span multiple engineering organizations and require deep technical understanding, rigorous execution, and strategic influence.
Operate as a single-threaded owner (STO) for the most critical programs, managing ambiguity, dependencies, and alignment across diverse technical teams.
Own the full lifecycle of programs—from ideation to execution to operational excellence—delivering outcomes that support Snap’s product, infrastructure, and platform goals.
Partner directly with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, influence technical decisions, and drive accountability.
Use hands-on data analytics (Python, SQL, dashboards, notebooks) to guide programs with data, uncover insights, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.
Contribute to Snap’s technical ecosystem by building automation tools, improving internal systems, and identifying opportunities for platform-wide transformation.
Work across both development programs (spanning multiple orgs with complex interdependencies) and platform excellence programs (focused on reliability, efficiency, and performance).
Drive the operating rhythm of the business, ensuring engineering systems scale effectively while remaining cost-conscious and performant
Mentor and grow other junior TPMs and Engineers to scale the performance of the org

new_jobs.description:
About Code Metal

Code Metal is the leader in automated software engineering you can trust. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck in software has shifted from writing code to verifying it works, and AI cannot verify its own work with certainty. Code Metal takes a fundamentally different approach: constrain AI to what it does reliably, verify every step independently of the model using formal methods, and keep engineers in the loop on the decisions that matter. The result isn't code that probably works — it's code that is provably correct, with auditable proof. Customers including the U.S. Air Force, L3Harris, RTX, and Toshiba use Code Metal to modernize legacy code, optimize performance on real hardware, and move prototypes to production, fast. Founded in 2023 with offices in Boston and San Francisco, Code Metal is funded by Accel, Salesforce Ventures, B Capital, Smith Point Capital, J2 Ventures, Shield Capital, Overmatch, RTX, and others.

Learn more at codemetal.ai.

About The Role

Code Metal is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex initiatives across a growing engineering organization. In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Solutions to advance Code Metal’s AI-powered code translation and verification platform.

You will work closely with technical and product leaders to translate strategic priorities into coordinated engineering programs, guide initiatives through the development lifecycle, and support successful end-to-end delivery. This role calls for technical fluency and the ability to navigate complex dependencies and tradeoffs while balancing near-term execution with long-term product and platform goals.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager - DEL
new_jobs.description:
Description

Leidos is seeking an experienced Program Manager (PM)
to lead and grow the DTRA Experimentation Lab (DEL) Program in Fort Belvoir, VA.
Serving as key personnel, the PM will provide overall program leadership and act as the primary integrator between the Leidos team and the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA) Research and Development (RD) Directorate. The PM will ensure customer projects, service desk requests, and operational priorities are effectively tracked, coordinated, and completed on schedule while maintaining a high standard of customer service and mission support. This role requires the ability to translate evolving mission needs into executable technical and operational outcomes, communicate effectively with both technical personnel and senior nontechnical stakeholders, and coordinate across multiple DTRA customers, including the RD Directorate, DTRA J6, facilities stakeholders, and DTRA cybersecurity offices.

The PM will lead the program's technical approach, including day-to-day operations, infrastructure sustainment, cybersecurity coordination, and proactive modernization initiatives. Key focus areas include the adoption of artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), engineering-task automation, and other improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, security, and mission effectiveness. The PM will work closely with Leidos finance, contracts, and technical leadership to maintain appropriate staffing levels and execute within the established contract budget, as well as interacting with Leidos personnel for technical innovation, meeting the program's Performance Work Statement (PWS). Responsibilities include budget planning for appropriate staffing needs and oversight for software licenses, hardware, infrastructure, and anticipated travel requirements, as applicable.

The successful candidate will lead with credibility, accountability, sound technical judgment, and empathy. The PM will empower Leidos and partner personnel, enable government customers (DTRA and other performers), identify and manage program risks, and drive measurable outcomes while upholding trust, integrity, and mission focus. The role requires a steady and decisive leader who can provide clear recommendations, articulate the rationale behind financial, technical and security-related decisions, and maintain disciplined execution in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

Salary Range: $125K to $165K

Program Summary

DTRA’s mission is to enable the Department of Defense (DoD), the Interagency, and International Partners to counter and deter Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and Improvised Threat Networks. The DEL’s mission is to serve as DTRA’s focal point for information technology (IT) integration, innovation, and collaboration, fostering customers’ mission, supporting cross-RD advanced R&D initiatives, maintaining awareness of and competence in trending technologies, and providing opportunities to leverage existing RD assets in support of operational and technical requirements.

Primary Responsibilities & Measures Of Success

Provide technically credible program leadership across DEL operations, architecture, cybersecurity, and modernization by identifying real risks, challenging incorrect assumptions, and protecting the networks from avoidable failures.

Measure of Success: Modernization and operational milestones are achieved on schedule and within contract and budget constraints, with no unplanned outages, security regressions, and with identified technical, contractual, and financial risks mitigated before they impact network or program performance.

Translate complex technical and operational realities into clear, actionable guidance for senior government and stakeholders to enable informed decision-making.

Measure of Success: Senior government and stakeholder decisions are made with clear understanding of technical risks, tradeoffs, and impacts, resulting in timely approvals, reduced rework or reversals, and demonstrably increased trust and engagement from DISA J6 leadership.

Identify, manage, and mitigate program risks (technical, operational, financial, contractual, and organizational) before they impact performance, cost, or credibility.

Measure of Success: Program risks across technical, operational, financial, contractual, and organizational domains are identified and mitigated early, resulting in stable execution with no avoidable cost growth, schedule slips, mission impacts, or loss of stakeholder confidence.

Elevate cybersecurity posture, ATO continuity, and risk governance by ensuring all modernization, migration, and engineering activities are planned and executed within RMF requirements, ATO constraints, and approved cyber risk tolerances, in close partnership with cyber and compliance leadership.

Measure of Success: The DEL team maintains continuous ATO authorization and cyber credibility throughout modernization and migration efforts, with POA&Ms and CORA findings proactively managed, no unplanned compliance-driven execution delays, and no mission impact resulting from unmanaged cyber or accreditation risk.

Build and sustain trusted relationships across Leidos, subcontractors, and government partners through integrity, consistency, accountability, and results.
Measure of Success: Leidos is viewed by government and industry partners as a reliable, mission-focused leader, evidenced by sustained customer confidence, effective collaboration across primes and subcontractors, and repeat engagement on complex or high-trust initiatives beyond baseline contract requirements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible, emotionally intelligent, ethically grounded PM who is calm under pressure, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and relentless about clarity and integrity. They lead through influence in environments with shared accountability and are comfortable making hard recommendations even when unpopular. They lead without ego, disagree without being disagreeable, and are willing to stand firm in support of the mission and the team.

Basic Qualifications

BA/BS or equivalent experience and 5+ years of prior relevant experience or master’s with 3+ years or prior relevant experience with autonomously guiding complex projects and operations across multiple related IT disciplines throughout the project lifecycle. Specific experience, education and training may be considered in lieu of degree.
2+ years of experience supervising or leading teams or projects.
Active DoW Secret level security clearance with ability to get Top Secret and be eligible for SCI at time of consideration.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience serving as the “single accountable voice” in contested environments.
Experience estimating technical and operations costs.
Experience identifying and assessing business impacts from proposed changes to a technical solution or enterprise operation.
Experience operating at Senior levels with accountability for enterprise outcomes.
Experience integrating subcontractor partners effectively into the mission.
Experience and ability to successfully negotiate and influence others to understand and accept new concepts, practices, and approaches.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

October 20, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Pay Range $107,900.00 - $195,050.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). new_jobs.title: Supply Chain Program Manager - Rack Integration
new_jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Hiring Locations:
Austin, US, New York, NY, San Francisco, CA, Seattle, WA, Washington DC, US

About The Department

The Infrastructure Engineering team builds and scales Cloudflare’s global network, ensuring high availability, security, and performance across hundreds of cities worldwide. Within Infrastructure Engineering, the Hardware Integration Operations team acts as the critical bridge connecting our global manufacturing partners, procurement teams, and capacity strategy. We manage the end-to-end flow of server and network hardware into fully integrated data center racks to support our growing global network. By working closely with external manufacturing partners and cross-functional teams, we ensure the infrastructure powering the internet is built, tested, and deployed efficiently, securely, and resiliently.

About The Role

As a Senior Supply Chain Program Manager, you will own the integrated supply-planning interface connecting capacity demand, L10 hardware supply, and L11 rack integration. In this senior individual contributor role, you will coordinate the transition of servers and network equipment from server-level manufacturing (L10) into complete rack integration (L11), providing global partners with the material readiness, capacity planning, and operational visibility needed to execute Cloudflare’s global expansion.

What You’ll Do

Drive Strategic Supply Planning: Connect capacity requirements with L10 hardware availability and L11 rack manufacturing schedules to maintain scalable supply plans across global regions.
Manage Material & Production Readiness: Oversee weekly supply allocation reporting, shortage reviews, and material-readiness assessments for upcoming rack integration builds.
Guide Operational Tradeoffs: Identify supply constraints and present actionable allocation options to Capacity Planning, evaluating tradeoffs between direct hardware shipping and complete rack integration.
Translate Long-Term Strategy: Convert quarterly and annual capacity forecasts into actionable operational requirements for L11 integration partners.
Monitor Program Financials & Progress: Track CapEx commitments against rack integration and deployment plans, giving leadership visibility into utilization, execution progress, and delivery risks.
Lead Supplier Relationships: Partner with global L11 integration providers through regular business reviews covering capacity, delivery, cost, quality, and performance.
Expand Resilient Manufacturing: Evaluate and recommend new L11 suppliers and build locations to strengthen geographic resiliency, capacity growth, and technical standards.
Support Commercial Operations: Validate supplier requisitions, purchase orders, and commercial agreements while supporting leadership approval workflows.
Partner on Global Supply Risk Mitigation: Collaborate with Capacity Planning, Procurement, and Hardware Sourcing to identify and mitigate rack integration risks involving capacity bottlenecks, logistics hurdles, tariffs, and regional concentration.
Partner on New Product Introductions (NPI): Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and rack integration teams to translate evolving hardware designs into operational preproduction and build readiness plans.
Support Supplier Quality: Analyze supplier-performance trends, coordinate escalations, and track cross-functional quality and engineering issues through resolution.
Operationalize ERP Workflows: Support adoption and stabilization of the team’s Oracle ERP processes, then identify improvements to planning, reporting, controls, and operational efficiency.
Deliver Executive Insights: Create clear forecasts, operational reporting, and risk assessments for leadership review.
Scale the Operating Model: Establish sustainable operational frameworks that expand production capacity while maximizing efficiency.

Required Qualifications

Broad professional experience in global supply chain management, production planning, manufacturing operations, or a related field.
Proven track record coordinating supply and production programs across multi-site manufacturing environments and international regions.
Demonstrated skill in connecting demand forecasts, material readiness, supplier capacity, and manufacturing schedules.
Experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs across engineering, procurement, finance, and external vendors.
Strong analytical skills with expertise in supply modeling, risk assessment, and operational reporting.
Demonstrated capability to manage supplier performance and lead business reviews at both operational and executive levels.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting strategic options and risks to leadership.
Ability to collaborate effectively across global time zones.

Desirable / Preferred Qualifications

Experience with contract manufacturing (CM), original design manufacturers (ODM), or systems integrators for data center, server, or network hardware.
Experience managing, optimizing, or stabilizing supply chain processes within an enterprise ERP platform (preferably Oracle).
Experience evaluating manufacturing partners, leading supplier assessments, or managing RFP processes.
Background in supporting commercial negotiations, procurement agreements, and supplier capacity commitments.
Familiarity with hardware new product introduction (NPI) and manufacturing transition processes.
Knowledge of global supply risk management, including tariff mitigation, logistics planning, and regional diversification.
Experience using performance scorecards and operational metrics to drive supplier accountability.
Willingness to travel occasionally for supplier site visits and operational reviews.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $189,000
For New York, Washington DC, Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $130,000 - $179,000
For Austin Texas based hires: Estimated annual salary of $108,000 - $149,000

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

modernization objectives, and mission critical service availability.

Exceptional communication skills in English — both written and oral — with the ability to effectively engage technical and non-technical stakeholders at all organizational levels, including senior government leadership.

Experience managing CDRL deliverable preparation and submission, including Monthly Status Reports, Staffing Matrices, and similar program documentation.

Strong risk management skills with the ability to identify, assess, document, and mitigate programmatic and technical risks.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or DAWIA Level III Program Management certification.

DoD 8570/8140 IAM Level II/III or IAT Level II/III baseline certification (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CASP+ CE, or Security+ CE).
Familiarity with Army and US Army enterprise IT environments, infrastructure, and service delivery frameworks.

Advanced knowledge of IT service management (ITSM) frameworks and enterprise IT operations including End-User Support, Network Engineering, Systems/Storage, Cyber Defense, and Telecommunications/LMR.

Active Top Secret/SCI clearance.

renewables and energy services
engineering and design
construction and facility services

To get where we’re going, we need big thinkers, problem solvers and collaborative mindsets. Does that sound like you?

The Opportunity with McKinstry

We are currently seeking a Program Manager to join our team as a member of our growing South Technical Services division. This position would play a key role in guiding and growing a dynamic team of building consultants. McKinstry has a unique perspective on the life of a building, and our Technical Services suite of owner-direct offerings helps our clients make good decisions that will improve the efficiency, comfort and lifespan of the building.

This person will be responsible for supporting projects in the MO region and across the South. Facility Condition Assessments
Preventative Maintenance Planning
Capital Planning

three key areas:

Project Planning & Delivery

You will serve as a technical leader with a focus on some or all of the programs listed above. You will provide technical support and guidance on a wide variety of projects in the areas of facilities management, energy efficiency, and commissioning. Working alongside project managers, you will determine the project approach and staffing required to produce high quality deliverables. Serving as a direct project participant or in an oversight QA/QC role, you will drive excellence in project delivery to ensure customer satisfaction while maintaining financial targets.

Business Development Support

You will serve as a key point of contact for McKinstry’s Business Development team for local sales pursuits. You will help develop customer solutions and act as a technical subject matter expert during client meetings. Your responsibilities will include pricing projects, reviewing proposals, managing scope and assumptions, and managing project risk.

Technical Leadership and Expertise

You will serve as a technical leader in facility operations and/or energy efficiency. You will be a go-to person for quality control and quality assurance for McKinstry projects. This role will include reviewing and optimizing our internal processes and tools to increase efficiency and quality of work.

Both through in-office conversations and in-field project work, you may have the opportunity to train junior engineers in technical concepts such as building operations, HVAC system design and operation, and identifying energy conservation measures. This position is likely to include people management responsibilities in the future.

What You Need To Succeed At McKinstry

Engineering/STEM Degree or equivalent work experience.
8+ years of relevant experience required.
Highly proficient in facility operations and/or HVAC systems
Experience presenting to clients and key-decision makers
Ability to read and understand construction documents (drawings, specifications, controls sequences, etc.).
Proficient in Communication/Teaming/Internal and External Interactions.
Experience working with Building Automation Systems preferred.

Credentials in engineering or building management (PE, FMP, CFM, LEED AP, etc) is preferred.

Competitive pay

Overview

At Credence, we support our clients' mission-critical needs, powered by technology. We provide cutting-edge solutions, including AI/ML, enterprise modernization, and advanced intelligence capabilities, to the largest defense and health federal organizations. Through partnership and trust, we increase mission success for war-fighters and secure our nation for a better future. 
We are privately held, are repeatedly recognized as a top place to work, and have been on the Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies list for the last 12 years. We practice servant leadership and believe that by focusing on the success of our clients, team members, and partners, we all achieve greater success. 
Credence has an immediate opening for a Senior Program Manager who will be primarily responsible for supporting the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center WAM (AFLCMC/WAM) directorate, F-16 division at WPAFB, OH. 
F-16 "Viper" AFLCMC/WAM is headquartered at Hill Air Force Base with units located at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Tyndall Air Force Base, Eglin Air Force Base, and Davis-Monthan Air Force Base.  The F-16 "Viper" is a multi-role fighter jet delivering air-to-air, air-to-ground, and surveillance capabilities for the United States Air Force (USAF) and Coalition Partners.
The F-16 program has the largest Foreign Military Sales (FMS) program in U.S. history producing over 4,500 jets for 24 countries.  Each F-16 FMS case is uniquely tailored to country requirements / development / funding.  Presently, FMS production orders exist through 2030. Additionally, the F-16 program includes the Multi-National Fighter Program (MNFP). MNFP is not a typical FMS program, but a unique, cooperative USAF and development program implemented through the FMS process under the framework of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU). MNFP began in 1975 with the countries of Belgium, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Norway; Portugal joined in 2000.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to the duties listed below

Assist in risk management, cost, schedule, and performance of various software development efforts in a program management role, and report on them monthly through use of the Project Management Resource Tool (PMRT).

Assist with project cost estimates and have knowledge of the system engineering process and project Configuration Management (CM) requirements.
Assist to investigate, analyze, plan, design, develop, implement, and evaluate solutions for project / program efforts; provide expert-level issue resolution and recommendation support to achieve desired program outcomes to situations that may include, but not be limited to, the following functional areas: program management, logistics, maintenance, supply, financial management (FM), test, security management, information management, and contracting.

Support F-16 avionics and weapons capabilities; complex weapon(s) integration; aircraft operations and employment; development of F-16 PVI; OFP software requirements development; development processes under the MNFP; aircraft mission and support equipment; authorized aircraft configurations and capabilities; aircraft subsystems; systems integration; advanced sensor integration
Coordinate the upgrade identification and requirements development process for new USAF hardware integration and software development programs. The Contractor shall complete program technical assessments and assist with developing cost estimates in support of the integration and software-development programs.  The Contractor shall support Government/Contractor work-share agreements between LM Aero to organic software development at OO-ALC, for development efforts and support complex subsystem integration/coordination for advanced sensors, weapons, and electronic warfare equipment

Assist with bridging process between acquisition and user communities such as military fighter/bomber pilots, navigators, weapons systems officers, and software development

in Springfield, VA

annually, accrued throughout the year plus 11 federal holidays. Paid leave accruals vary by contract and are established based on customer requirements and the contractual level of effort. .

Position Summary

This position requires in-depth understanding of Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance operations and strong communication skills. The position will require working closely with senior government officials and foreign dignitaries.

Required Experience And Qualifications

Active TS/SCI
Willingness to submit to a CI Polygraph
8 years of total work experience (7/Masters, 6/Doctorate)
Bachelor’s Degree in a business or engineering related field
6 years of demonstrated specialized experience with NGA, DoD, or other IC Agencies acquisition processes and procedures.
6 years of demonstrated specialized experience in program/project management.

Demonstrated specialized experience in applying system engineering processes, particularly requirements analysis, interface definition, or detailed implementation planning of large complex systems or enterprises and enterprise-wide interoperability.

new_jobs.title: SAP - Plant Maintenance - EAM - Implementation Manager - Consulting - Location OPEN
new_jobs.description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Our objective is to provide clients with a unique business perspective on how to leverage SAP technology to improve their operations. This is rooted in EY’s SAP service line capabilities (Supply Chain, FICO, BPC, Data & Analytics, Customer, Tech/Arch and SuccessFactors) that are focused on helping clients improve performance and increase productivity.

The opportunity

EY's Agile Business Transformation enabled by SAP technology can help organizations address challenges in the digital era. Our EY SAP collaborative approach focuses on more than technology alone. We take a comprehensive, business-first view to address strategy, customer value, user experiences, processes, technology, and operational impacts in tandem.

In this role, you will interact with business stakeholders to evaluate business models, processes, and operations. You will gather, understand, and analyze business requirements, translating them into technical specifications. Additionally, you will analyze newly implemented technology solutions to ensure they meet business requirements and collaborate with technical teams to design and deliver system architecture solutions.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Manager in Technology Analysis, you will play a pivotal role in managing and delivering complex technical initiatives. You will face challenges that require innovative problem-solving and analytical skills, providing you with opportunities to grow and learn in a dynamic environment.

Lead workstream delivery and ensure effective management of processes and solutions.
Track deliverable completion and project status, ensuring alignment with performance objectives.
Actively participate in client working sessions, leading workstreams from planning through execution and closure.
Demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and possess strong business acumen. Demonstrate ability to assimilate new knowledge.
Consistently deliver quality client services. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
Establish relationships with client personnel at appropriate levels.
Facilitate requirement gathering and lead design workshops during explore, configuration, unit testing phases; document functional specifications for design gaps during build phase; assist the client in all testing cycles; deliver training prior to go-live; and provide post go-live support.
Stay current with the annual releases of new Asset Management (Plant Maintenance) functionalities from SAP.
Collaborate within a team across workstreams (procurement, project systems, finance, quality management, production, materials management, warehouse management, supply chain, and IBP) to design, test, and deploy SAP solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To thrive in this role, you will need a blend of technical and interpersonal skills. Your ability to build relationships and communicate effectively will be crucial in delivering exceptional client service.

On your typical engagement, you will work with the key stakeholders to understand their needs and advise on the SAP Asset Management system capabilities. You will initiate the requirement gathering, architect solutions, blueprinting, testing, complete the workflow and documentation, as well as the functional design of the solution. Liaise with the stakeholders and technical team to translate needs into business solutions and complete the configurations and/or integrations with SAP and non-SAP systems.

Strong analytical skills to develop solutions to complex problems.
Proven ability to manage engagement economics and resource planning.
Experience in leading teams and managing change effectively.
Ability to identify opportunities for additional services and lead specific RFP responses.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).
Typically, no less than 4 - 6 years’ relevant experience working with SAP Asset Management/Plant Maintenance (PM)/Enterprise Asset Management (EAM).
Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills.
Strong understanding of Asset Management principles and practices.
Experience managing an SAP project or workstream and project-based team members.
Knowledge of leading practices, benchmarking, peer company environments and prior advisory experience relevant to industry specific finance and technology functions.
Ability and comfort level researching client inquiries and emerging issues, including regulations, industry practices, and new technologies.
A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience in managing client relationships and expectations.
A strong background in technology analysis and implementation.
Prior consulting industry experience
Multiple end-to-end life cycle implementations of SAP S/4 HANA or SAP ECC
Experience with Fiori
SAP Certification(s)
Experience in industries such as manufacturing, utilities, mining and metal, or oil and gas (energy)
Experience with one of the following additional licensed products:
3rd party planning and scheduling tools
3rd party MRO master data governance tools
SAP service and asset management (mobility)
SAP field service management
SAP resource scheduling for maintenance planners (RSH)
SAP business network asset collaboration
SAP asset performance management
SAP spatial asset management
SAP work clearance management (lock out tag out)
SAP geographical enablement framework
SAP environmental health & safety

What We Look For

We seek individuals who are not only technically proficient but also possess the qualities of a leader. Top performers are proactive, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement. They thrive in collaborative environments and are passionate about delivering exceptional results for clients.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $142,600 to $261,500. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $171,200 to $297,200. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

You Are

A delivery-focused Workday Project Manager who can bring structure to complex programs, build trusted client relationships, and lead cross-functional teams toward clear outcomes. You understand that successful Workday delivery requires more than maintaining a plan. It requires proactive decision-making, disciplined governance, transparent risk management, commercial awareness, and the ability to keep business and technology stakeholders aligned.

Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth

i2G specializes in advanced physical electronic security and life safety solutions. I2G has proven experience in surveillance, access control, and intrusion detection systems, biometrics, fence sensors, radars, ground sensors, anti-drone technologies, and more. We excel in design, project management, commissioning, and enterprise technology integrations.

i2G’s mission is to provide the products and services that meet our customers’ needs to give them a vital advantage in today’s market, helping to protect what matters most.

We are seeking a Electronic Security Project Manager
to coordinate and execute physical security installations across client sites. In this role, you will take operational ownership of multiple projects simultaneously—ensuring deployments are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with client specifications.

Working alongside local engineering, sales, and technical teams, you will manage field crews (Senior/Lead Technicians, Junior Technicians) and subcontractors. You will be responsible for active site coordination, milestone tracking, material logistics, job profitability, and continuous stakeholder communication from kickoff through sign-off.

Applicants for this role must have Property Technology Security backgrounds!

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Schedule Tracking: Coordinate day-to-day operations for multiple concurrent security integration projects. Maintain project schedules, monitor progress against established baselines, track job costs, and mitigate delivery delays.
Field & Subcontractor Coordination: Supervise installation crews and specialized low-voltage subcontractors. Ensure field work complies with scopes of work (SOW), client quality standards, and OSHA/job-site safety regulations.
Site Verification & Readiness: Conduct pre-installation site walks to evaluate electrical, network, and pathway dependencies. Proactively identify site readiness issues or physical impediments, communicating risks promptly to stakeholders.
Technical Oversite: Review security system drawing sets, floor plans, riser diagrams, and basic civil/electrical prints. Work with integration engineers to ensure accurate programming and configuration of access control, video management, intrusion detection, and intercom systems.
Change Management & Financials: Track labor hours and project materials, manage inventory staging, and process red-line drawings. Identify out-of-scope work and collaborate with account teams to generate formal change orders
Commissioning & Punch List Closeout: Coordinate system testing, functional checkout, and client acceptance walks. Rapidly clear punch list items, collect final sign-offs, assemble closeout documentation, and assist with proposal estimations as needed.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in the electronic security, low-voltage, or commercial systems integration field, with at least 2–3 years in a project management or project coordination capacity.
Domain Focus: Prior experience within Property Technology (PropTech), commercial real estate, or enterprise electronic security environments
Technical Knowledge: Working familiarity with enterprise access control and video surveillance platforms such as LenelS2, Software House (C
CURE), Axis, Verint, Commend, DMP, or integrated fire/alarm panels. Factory certifications are a plus.
Software Tools: Working proficiency with MS Office 365 (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams) and project management/scheduling platforms (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, SimPRO)
Industry Credentials: Certified Security Project Manager (CSPM) or PMP certification (or progress toward certification) is preferred but not required.
General Requirements: Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record; ability to walk job sites and navigate active construction environments; must be able to pass a background check and drug screen.

You're both an operator and a builder: running many customer deployments at once, and turning what works into playbooks the whole team can run.

Own each customer's deployment end to end: set up their workspace, migrate their data, build their customer memory, and enable their team, so Lightfield becomes the system their company runs on
Deliver pipeline generation for a portfolio of customers: understand each business, define the ICP and targeting strategy, and direct Lightfield's agents from first outreach to booked meetings

Turn what works into playbooks, and feed what you learn back to product so the agents get better

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position Reports To

Business Process Manager

We Are Hiring 3 Implementation Managers To Drive Our Global Quote-to-Order Transformation. You Will Join a Key Initiative To Standardize Commercial Processes And Digital Solutions Across Our Business. Apply For The Region That Matches Your Profile And Career Aspirations

Europe — Flexible location across European countries
America — Flexible location across American countries
Asia — Flexible location across Asia (excl. China)

Each role is autonomous and high-impact, with direct influence on how our commercial operations work in your region.

About The Role

Join ABB Robotics as an Implementation Manager and drive the implementation and adoption of our global Quote-to-Order process and supporting digital solutions.

The role will work closely with country commercial organizations to understand their current ways of working, introduce the global Quote-to-Order process, identify gaps and local requirements, and support countries through the transition to the target process and tools. The current solution landscape includes CPQ and the commercial Quote-to-Order processes interfacing with SAP S/4HANA
, together with other supporting applications. The scope may evolve as the Quote-to-Order process and application landscape develops. The position is part of the Commercial Excellence – Quote to Order Process
organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.
Act as the primary business process advisor and second-level tool support contact for your region's countries — balancing process discipline with pragmatic tool troubleshooting
Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.
Act as the primary Quote-to-Order implementation contact for your region’s countries, building trusted relationships with sales organizations and key stakeholders.
Build strong relationships with country Sales organizations and key stakeholders. Understand existing country commercial processes, requirements and ways of working and support countries through the change management process.
Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.
Good understanding of commercial processes such as quotation, pricing, configuration, sales operations or order handling.
Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.
Experience with commercial processes integrated with SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP environments is an advantage.
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills. You are equally confident with business and technical audiences.
Experience working across multiple countries and in matrix organizations; structured, self-driven and ownership-oriented.
Fluent in English; local or regional language skills are an advantage. Willingness to travel frequently within your region, particularly during implementation phases.

The Ideal Candidate

You combine commercial understanding, process orientation and change management expertise. You know how to sit with a country team, understand how they work today, and guide them confidently toward a standardized global process, without losing sight of legitimate local needs. You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

Compensation Package
